title: ARYA: A Physics-Constrained Composable & Deterministic World Model Architecture
summary: This paper presents ARYA, a composable, physics-constrained, deterministic world model architecture built on five foundational principles: nano models, composability, causal reasoning, determinism, and architectural AI safety. We demonstrate that ARYA satisfies all canonical world model requirements, including state representation, dynamic prediction, causal and physical awareness, temporal consistency, generalization, learnability, and planning and control. Unlike monolithic foundation models, the ARYA foundation model implements these capabilities through a hierarchical system-of-system-of-systems of specialized nano models, orchestrated by AARA (ARYA Autonomous Research Agent), an always-on cognitive daemon that executes a continuous sense-decide-act-learn loop. The nano model architecture provides linear scaling, sparse activation, selective untraining, and sub-20-second training cycles, resolving the traditional tension between capability and computational efficiency. A central contribution is the Unfireable Safety Kernel: an architecturally immutable safety boundary that cannot be disabled or circumvented by any system component, including its own self-improvement engine. This is not a social or ethical alignment statement; it is a technical framework ensuring human control persists as autonomy increases. Safety is an architectural constraint governing every operation, not a policy layer applied after the fact. We present formal alignment between ARYA's architecture and canonical world model requirements, and report summarizing its state-of-the-art performance across 6 of 9 competitive benchmarks head-to-head with GPT-5.2, Opus 4.6, and V-JEPA-2. All with zero neural network parameters, across seven active industry domain nodes spanning aerospace, pharma manufacturing, oil and gas, smart cities, biotech, defense, and medical devices.
tldr: The paper introduces ARYA, a composable, physics-constrained, deterministic world model architecture consisting of nano-models orchestrated by an autonomous research agent with a built-in unfireable safety kernel, achieving state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks with zero neural network parameters.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种可组合的、受物理约束的、确定性的世界模型架构ARYA，它由纳米模型组成，由一个具有内置不可触发安全内核的自主研究代理组织，在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，且零神经网络参数。
summary_zh: 本文提出 ARYA，一种基于五个基本原则构建的可组合、受物理约束的确定性世界模型架构：纳米模型、可组合性、因果推理、确定性和架构人工智能安全。我们证明 ARYA 满足所有规范的世界模型要求，包括状态表示、动态预测、因果和物理感知、时间一致性、泛化能力、可学习性、规划和控制。与单体基础模型不同，ARYA 基础模型通过专门的纳米模型的层级系统来实现这些能力，这些纳米模型由 AARA（ARYA 自主研究代理）协调，AARA 是一个始终在线的认知守护进程，执行持续的感知-决策-行动-学习循环。纳米模型架构提供线性缩放、稀疏激活、选择性撤销训练和低于 20 秒的训练周期，解决了能力和计算效率之间的传统矛盾。一个核心贡献是不可触发的安全内核：一个架构上不可变的安全边界，不能被任何系统组件禁用或规避，包括其自身的自我改进引擎。这不是一个社会或伦理对齐声明；它是一个技术框架，确保随着自主性的提高，人类的控制得以持续。安全是约束每个操作的架构约束，而不是事后应用的策略层。我们展示了 ARYA 的架构和规范的世界模型要求之间的正式对齐，并报告了其在 6 个（共 9 个）竞争性基准测试中与 GPT-5.2、Opus 4.6 和 V-JEPA-2 的直接比较中的最先进性能。所有这些都基于零神经网络参数，横跨航空航天、制药制造、石油和天然气、智慧城市、生物技术、国防和医疗设备等七个活跃的行业领域节点。

title: DyGeoVLN: Infusing Dynamic Geometry Foundation Model into Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to understand visual observations and language instructions to navigate in unseen environments. Most existing approaches rely on static scene assumptions and struggle to generalize in dynamic, real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose DyGeoVLN, a dynamic geometry-aware VLN framework. Our method infuses a dynamic geometry foundation model into the VLN framework through cross-branch feature fusion to enable explicit 3D spatial representation and visual-semantic reasoning. To efficiently compress historical token information in long-horizon, dynamic navigation, we further introduce a novel pose-free and adaptive-resolution token-pruning strategy. This strategy can remove spatio-temporal redundant tokens to reduce inference cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks and exhibits strong robustness in real-world environments.
tldr: DyGeoVLN addresses the challenge of Vision-Language Navigation in dynamic environments by infusing a dynamic geometry foundation model and introducing a novel token pruning strategy, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: DyGeoVLN通过融合动态几何基础模型并引入新的token剪枝策略，解决了动态环境下的视觉语言导航问题，并取得了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求智能体理解视觉观察和语言指令，从而在未见过的环境中导航。现有的大多数方法依赖于静态场景假设，难以在动态、真实世界的场景中泛化。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了DyGeoVLN，一个动态几何感知的VLN框架。我们的方法通过跨分支特征融合，将动态几何基础模型注入到VLN框架中，以实现显式的3D空间表示和视觉语义推理。为了在长程、动态导航中高效压缩历史令牌信息，我们进一步引入了一种新颖的、无姿态的自适应分辨率令牌剪枝策略。该策略能够移除时空冗余令牌，从而降低推理成本。大量的实验表明，我们的方法在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，并在真实世界环境中展现出强大的鲁棒性。

title: Cortical Policy: A Dual-Stream View Transformer for Robotic Manipulation
summary: View transformers process multi-view observations to predict actions and have shown impressive performance in robotic manipulation. Existing methods typically extract static visual representations in a view-specific manner, leading to inadequate 3D spatial reasoning ability and a lack of dynamic adaptation. Taking inspiration from how the human brain integrates static and dynamic views to address these challenges, we propose Cortical Policy, a novel dual-stream view transformer for robotic manipulation that jointly reasons from static-view and dynamic-view streams. The static-view stream enhances spatial understanding by aligning features of geometrically consistent keypoints extracted from a pretrained 3D foundation model. The dynamic-view stream achieves adaptive adjustment through position-aware pretraining of an egocentric gaze estimation model, computationally replicating the human cortical dorsal pathway. Subsequently, the complementary view representations of both streams are integrated to determine the final actions, enabling the model to handle spatially-complex and dynamically-changing tasks under language conditions. Empirical evaluations on RLBench, the challenging COLOSSEUM benchmark, and real-world tasks demonstrate that Cortical Policy outperforms state-of-the-art baselines substantially, validating the superiority of dual-stream design for visuomotor control. Our cortex-inspired framework offers a fresh perspective for robotic manipulation and holds potential for broader application in vision-based robot control.
tldr: The paper introduces Cortical Policy, a dual-stream view transformer inspired by the human brain for robotic manipulation, improving spatial reasoning and dynamic adaptation by combining static and dynamic view processing. It outperforms SOTA baselines on multiple benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Cortical Policy，一种受人类大脑启发的双流视觉变换器，用于机器人操作。它通过结合静态和动态视图处理，提高了空间推理和动态适应能力。在多个benchmark和真实世界任务中，该方法优于当前的state-of-the-art。
summary_zh: 视角变换器处理多视角观测以预测动作，并在机器人操作中表现出令人印象深刻的性能。现有方法通常以视角特定的方式提取静态视觉表征，导致3D空间推理能力不足，并且缺乏动态适应性。受人类大脑如何整合静态和动态视角以应对这些挑战的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的双流视角变换器——皮层策略（Cortical Policy），用于机器人操作，它联合推理来自静态视角流和动态视角流的信息。静态视角流通过对齐从预训练的3D基础模型中提取的几何一致的关键点特征来增强空间理解能力。动态视角流通过对以位置感知为基础的以自我为中心的注视点估计模型进行预训练来实现自适应调整，在计算上复制了人类皮层背侧通路。随后，整合来自两个流的互补视角表征以确定最终动作，从而使模型能够在语言条件下处理空间上复杂和动态变化的任务。在RLBench、具有挑战性的COLOSSEUM基准和真实世界任务中的经验评估表明，皮层策略大幅优于最先进的基线，从而验证了双流设计在视觉运动控制方面的优越性。我们受皮层启发的框架为机器人操作提供了一个新的视角，并具有在基于视觉的机器人控制中更广泛应用的潜力。

title: RoboAlign: Learning Test-Time Reasoning for Language-Action Alignment in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Improving embodied reasoning in multimodal-large-language models (MLLMs) is essential for building vision-language-action models (VLAs) on top of them to readily translate multimodal understanding into low-level actions. Accordingly, recent work has explored enhancing embodied reasoning in MLLMs through supervision of vision-question-answering type. However, these approaches have been reported to result in unstable VLA performance, often yielding only marginal or even negative gains. In this paper, we propose a more systematic MLLM training framework RoboAlign that reliably improves VLA performance. Our key idea is to sample action tokens via zero-shot natural language reasoning and refines this reasoning using reinforcement learning (RL) to improve action accuracy. As a result, RoboAlign bridges the modality gap between language and low-level actions in MLLMs, and facilitate knowledge transfer from MLLM to VLA. To validate the effectiveness of RoboAlign, we train VLAs by adding a diffusion-based action head on top of an MLLM backbone and evaluate them on major robotics benchmarks. Remarkably, by performing RL-based alignment after SFT using less than 1\% of the data, RoboAlign achieves performance improvements of 17.5\%, 18.9\%, and 106.6\% over SFT baselines on LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-world environments, respectively.
tldr: The paper introduces RoboAlign, a framework that uses zero-shot reasoning and reinforcement learning to align language and actions in vision-language-action models (VLAs), leading to significant improvements in robotics benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 RoboAlign 框架，该框架使用零样本推理和强化学习来对齐视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 中的语言和动作，从而显著改进了机器人技术基准。
summary_zh: 提升多模态大语言模型(MLLM)中的具身推理能力，对于在其基础上构建能够便捷地将多模态理解转化为底层动作的视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)至关重要。因此，最近的研究探索了通过视觉-问答类型监督来增强MLLM中的具身推理能力。然而，据报道，这些方法会导致VLA性能不稳定，往往只能产生微弱甚至负面的增益。在本文中，我们提出了一种更系统的MLLM训练框架RoboAlign，可以可靠地提升VLA性能。我们的核心思想是通过零样本自然语言推理来采样动作令牌，并利用强化学习(RL)对这种推理进行精炼，以提高动作准确性。因此，RoboAlign弥合了MLLM中语言和底层动作之间的模态差距，并促进了从MLLM到VLA的知识迁移。为了验证RoboAlign的有效性，我们通过在MLLM骨干网络之上添加基于扩散的动作头来训练VLA，并在主要的机器人基准测试中对其进行评估。值得注意的是，通过使用不到1%的数据在SFT之后进行基于RL的对齐，RoboAlign在LIBERO、CALVIN和真实世界环境中，分别实现了比SFT基线高17.5%、18.9%和106.6%的性能提升。

title: GAPG: Geometry Aware Push-Grasping Synergy for Goal-Oriented Manipulation in Clutter
summary: Grasping target objects is a fundamental skill for robotic manipulation, but in cluttered environments with stacked or occluded objects, a single-step grasp is often insufficient. To address this, previous work has introduced pushing as an auxiliary action to create graspable space. However, these methods often struggle with both stability and efficiency because they neglect the scene's geometric information, which is essential for evaluating grasp robustness and ensuring that pushing actions are safe and effective. To this end, we propose a geometry-aware push-grasp synergy framework that leverages point cloud data to integrate grasp and push evaluation. Specifically, the grasp evaluation module analyzes the geometric relationship between the gripper's point cloud and the points enclosed within its closing region to determine grasp feasibility and stability. Guided by this, the push evaluation module predicts how pushing actions influence future graspable space, enabling the robot to select actions that reliably transform non-graspable states into graspable ones. By jointly reasoning about geometry in both grasping and pushing, our framework achieves safer, more efficient, and more reliable manipulation in cluttered settings. Our method is extensively tested in simulation and real-world environments in various scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that our model generalizes well to real-world scenes and unseen objects.
tldr: This paper presents a geometry-aware push-grasp synergy framework using point clouds to improve robotic manipulation in cluttered environments, enabling more robust and efficient grasping by integrating grasp and push evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种几何感知推-抓协同框架，利用点云数据来提升在杂乱环境中机器人操作的性能。该框架通过整合抓取和推动评估，实现了更鲁棒和高效的抓取。
summary_zh: 抓取目标物体是机器人操作的一项基本技能，但在拥挤的环境中，存在堆叠或遮挡的物体时，单步抓取往往是不够的。为了解决这个问题，先前的工作引入了推作为辅助动作来创造可抓取的空间。然而，这些方法常常在稳定性和效率方面遇到困难，因为它们忽略了场景的几何信息，而这些信息对于评估抓取的鲁棒性以及确保推动动作的安全有效至关重要。为此，我们提出了一种几何感知的推-抓协同框架，该框架利用点云数据来整合抓取和推动的评估。具体而言，抓取评估模块分析夹爪点云与其闭合区域内包含的点之间的几何关系，以确定抓取的可行性和稳定性。在此基础上，推动评估模块预测推动动作如何影响未来的可抓取空间，从而使机器人能够选择可靠地将不可抓取状态转换为可抓取状态的动作。通过联合推理抓取和推动过程中的几何信息，我们的框架在拥挤环境中实现了更安全、更高效、更可靠的操作。我们的方法在各种场景的仿真和真实环境中进行了广泛的测试。实验结果表明，我们的模型能够很好地泛化到真实场景和未见过的物体。

title: Dynamic Control Barrier Function Regulation with Vision-Language Models for Safe, Adaptive, and Realtime Visual Navigation
summary: Robots operating in dynamic, unstructured environments must balance safety and efficiency under potentially limited sensing. While control barrier functions (CBFs) provide principled collision avoidance via safety filtering, their behavior is often governed by fixed parameters that can be overly conservative in benign scenes or overly permissive near hazards. We present AlphaAdj, a vision-to-control navigation framework that uses egocentric RGB input to adapt the conservativeness of a CBF safety filter in real time. A vision-language model(VLM) produces a bounded scalar risk estimate from the current camera view, which we map to dynamically update a CBF parameter that modulates how strongly safety constraints are enforced. To address asynchronous inference and non-trivial VLM latency in practice, we combine a geometric, speed-aware dynamic cap and a staleness-gated fusion policy with lightweight implementation choices that reduce end-to-end inference overhead. We evaluate AlphaAdj across multiple static and dynamic obstacle scenarios in a variety of environments, comparing against fixed-parameter and uncapped ablations. Results show that AlphaAdj maintains collision-free navigation while improving efficiency (in terms of path length and time to goal) by up to 18.5% relative to fixed settings and improving robustness and success rate relative to an uncapped baseline.
tldr: This paper introduces AlphaAdj, a vision-language framework that dynamically adjusts Control Barrier Function (CBF) parameters based on visual risk assessment for safer and more efficient robot navigation in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍AlphaAdj，一个基于视觉语言的框架，通过基于视觉风险评估动态调整控制屏障函数（CBF）参数，从而在动态环境中实现更安全、更高效的机器人导航。
summary_zh: 在动态、非结构化环境中运行的机器人必须在潜在的有限感知条件下平衡安全性和效率。虽然控制障碍函数（CBFs）通过安全滤波提供有原则的避撞，但其行为通常受固定参数控制，这些参数在良性场景中可能过于保守，而在危险附近可能过于宽松。本文提出了一种视觉到控制的导航框架AlphaAdj，它使用以自我为中心的RGB输入来实时调整CBF安全滤波的保守性。视觉-语言模型（VLM）从当前相机视图中生成一个有界的标量风险估计，我们将其映射以动态更新一个CBF参数，该参数调节安全约束的强制程度。为了解决实际中异步推理和非平凡的VLM延迟问题，我们将几何的、速度感知的动态上限和一个陈旧性门控的融合策略与轻量级的实现选择相结合，从而降低端到端推理开销。我们在各种环境中的多个静态和动态障碍场景中评估了AlphaAdj，并与固定参数和无上限烧蚀实验进行了比较。结果表明，AlphaAdj在保持无碰撞导航的同时，将效率（在路径长度和到达目标时间方面）相对于固定设置提高了高达18.5%，并相对于无上限基线提高了鲁棒性和成功率。

title: CounterScene: Counterfactual Causal Reasoning in Generative World Models for Safety-Critical Closed-Loop Evaluation
summary: Generating safety-critical driving scenarios requires understanding why dangerous interactions arise, rather than merely forcing collisions. However, existing methods rely on heuristic adversarial agent selection and unstructured perturbations, lacking explicit modeling of interaction dependencies and thus exhibiting a realism--adversarial trade-off. We present CounterScene, a framework that endows closed-loop generative BEV world models with structured counterfactual reasoning for safety-critical scenario generation. Given a safe scene, CounterScene asks: what if the causally critical agent had behaved differently? To answer this, we introduce causal adversarial agent identification to identify the critical agent and classify conflict types, and develop a conflict-aware interactive world model in which a causal interaction graph is used to explicitly model dynamic inter-agent dependencies. Building on this structure, stage-adaptive counterfactual guidance performs minimal interventions on the identified agent, removing its spatial and temporal safety margins while allowing risk to emerge through natural interaction propagation. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate that CounterScene achieves the strongest adversarial effectiveness while maintaining superior trajectory realism across all horizons, improving long-horizon collision rate from 12.3% to 22.7% over the strongest baseline with better realism (ADE 1.88 vs.2.09). Notably, this advantage further widens over longer rollouts, and CounterScene generalizes zero-shot to nuPlan with state-of-the-art realism.
tldr: The paper introduces CounterScene, a framework using counterfactual causal reasoning in generative world models to create safety-critical driving scenarios by identifying critical agents and modeling inter-agent dependencies, achieving stronger adversarial effectiveness and better realism than existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CounterScene，一个利用生成世界模型中的反事实因果推理来创建安全关键驾驶场景的框架，通过识别关键主体并建模主体间的依赖关系，实现了比现有方法更强的对抗有效性和更好的真实性。
summary_zh: 生成安全攸关的驾驶场景需要理解危险交互产生的原因，而不仅仅是强迫碰撞的发生。然而，现有方法依赖于启发式的对抗代理选择和非结构化的扰动，缺乏对交互依赖性的显式建模，因此表现出真实性与对抗性的权衡。我们提出了CounterScene，一个赋予闭环生成式BEV世界模型以结构化反事实推理的框架，用于安全攸关的场景生成。给定一个安全场景，CounterScene会问：如果因果关键代理的行为不同会怎样？为了回答这个问题，我们引入了因果对抗代理识别来识别关键代理并对冲突类型进行分类，并开发了一个冲突感知交互世界模型，其中使用因果交互图来显式地建模动态的代理间依赖性。基于这一结构，阶段自适应的反事实引导对识别出的代理执行最小干预，消除其空间和时间安全裕度，同时允许风险通过自然交互传播而显现。在nuScenes上的大量实验表明，CounterScene实现了最强的对抗有效性，同时在所有时间范围内保持了卓越的轨迹真实性，相对于最强的基线，长时程碰撞率从12.3%提高到22.7%，且具有更好的真实性（ADE 1.88 vs. 2.09）。值得注意的是，这种优势在更长的推演中进一步扩大，并且CounterScene能够零样本泛化到nuPlan，并具有最先进的真实性。

title: Dreaming the Unseen: World Model-regularized Diffusion Policy for Out-of-Distribution Robustness
summary: Diffusion policies excel at visuomotor control but often fail catastrophically under severe out-of-distribution (OOD) disturbances, such as unexpected object displacements or visual corruptions. To address this vulnerability, we introduce the Dream Diffusion Policy (DDP), a framework that deeply integrates a diffusion world model into the policy's training objective via a shared 3D visual encoder. This co-optimization endows the policy with robust state-prediction capabilities. When encountering sudden OOD anomalies during inference, DDP detects the real-imagination discrepancy and actively abandons the corrupted visual stream. Instead, it relies on its internal "imagination" (autoregressively forecasted latent dynamics) to safely bypass the disruption, generating imagined trajectories before smoothly realigning with physical reality. Extensive evaluations demonstrate DDP's exceptional resilience. Notably, DDP achieves a 73.8% OOD success rate on MetaWorld (vs. 23.9% without predictive imagination) and an 83.3% success rate under severe real-world spatial shifts (vs. 3.3% without predictive imagination). Furthermore, as a stress test, DDP maintains a 76.7% real-world success rate even when relying entirely on open-loop imagination post-initialization.
tldr: The paper introduces Dream Diffusion Policy (DDP), a framework that integrates a diffusion world model into the policy's training to achieve out-of-distribution robustness by detecting anomalies and relying on internal imagination to bypass disruptions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Dream Diffusion Policy (DDP)，它将扩散世界模型整合到策略的训练中，通过检测异常并依靠内部想象来绕过中断，从而实现分布外鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 扩散策略在视觉运动控制方面表现出色，但在严重的分布外（OOD）干扰下，例如意外的物体位移或视觉损坏，常常会遭遇灾难性失败。为了解决这种脆弱性，我们引入了梦想扩散策略（DDP），该框架通过共享的3D视觉编码器将扩散世界模型深度集成到策略的训练目标中。这种协同优化赋予策略强大的状态预测能力。当在推理过程中遇到突发的OOD异常时，DDP会检测到真实-想象的差异，并主动放弃损坏的视觉流。相反，它依靠其内部的“想象”（自回归预测的潜在动态）来安全地绕过干扰，生成想象的轨迹，然后在平稳地与物理现实重新对齐。广泛的评估证明了DDP卓越的鲁棒性。值得注意的是，DDP在MetaWorld上实现了73.8%的OOD成功率（没有预测想象为23.9%），并且在严重的真实空间偏移下实现了83.3%的成功率（没有预测想象为3.3%）。此外，作为压力测试，即使完全依赖初始化后的开环想象，DDP仍保持76.7%的真实世界成功率。

title: Prompt replay: speeding up grpo with on-policy reuse of high-signal prompts
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) plays a crucial role in expanding the capacities of LLM reasoning, but GRPO-style training is dominated by expensive rollouts and wastes compute on unusable prompts. We propose Prompt Replay, an overhead-free online data selection method for GRPO that reuses prompts only (not trajectories), to preserve on-policy optimization. After each step, we insert prompts with medium difficulty into a buffer, and prioritize prompts closer to a pass rate of 0.5 (half answers correct, half wrong) to maximize the advantage, thus learning signal. Training batches are formed by mixing reused prompts with fresh samples, with cooldown steps and max reuse times controlling aggressiveness vs risk of overfitting. Across multiple model families (Llama-3.2- 3B, Qwen3-8B) and training datasets (Dolci, Polaris), evaluated using average accuracy on six standard math benchmarks, Prompt Replay reduces zero-variance prompts, increases mean absolute advantage and shows faster initial accuracy gains. Yet, it plateaus and converges with the baseline, as too aggressive configuration was used. The method is most efficient when the rollouts are the primary bottleneck and the dataset is difficult for the model. We additionally observe that Qwen2.5-Math can exhibit spurious-reward effects that invalidates ablations, raising a warning signal for using it as a sole testbed for GRPO method research.
tldr: The paper introduces Prompt Replay, an online data selection method for GRPO that reuses high-signal prompts to improve training efficiency, particularly in scenarios where rollouts are a bottleneck and the dataset is challenging.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为Prompt Replay的在线数据选择方法，用于GRPO训练，重复利用高信号提示以提高训练效率，尤其是在rollout成为瓶颈且数据集具有挑战性的情况下。
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在扩展 LLM 推理能力方面起着关键作用，但 GRPO 风格的训练受制于昂贵的 rollouts，并在无用提示上浪费计算资源。我们提出 Prompt Replay，一种用于 GRPO 的零开销在线数据选择方法，它仅重用提示（而非轨迹），以保持 on-policy 优化。在每个步骤之后，我们将具有中等难度的提示插入到缓冲区中，并优先处理通过率接近 0.5（一半答案正确，一半错误）的提示，以最大化优势，从而学习信号。训练批次通过将重用提示与新样本混合形成，通过冷却步骤和最大重用次数来控制激进程度与过拟合风险。跨多个模型家族（Llama-3.2- 3B、Qwen3-8B）和训练数据集（Dolci、Polaris），使用六个标准数学基准的平均准确率进行评估，Prompt Replay 减少了零方差提示，增加了平均绝对优势，并显示了更快的初始准确率提升。然而，由于使用了过于激进的配置，它会达到平台期并与基线收敛。当 rollouts 是主要瓶颈且数据集对模型来说很困难时，该方法最有效。我们还观察到 Qwen2.5-Math 可能表现出虚假奖励效应，使消融研究失效，这为将其用作 GRPO 方法研究的唯一试验台提出了警告信号。

title: Rethinking Plasticity in Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper investigates the fundamental mechanisms driving plasticity loss in deep reinforcement learning (RL), a critical challenge where neural networks lose their ability to adapt to non-stationary environments. While existing research often relies on descriptive metrics like dormant neurons or effective rank, these summaries fail to explain the underlying optimization dynamics. We propose the Optimization-Centric Plasticity (OCP) hypothesis, which posits that plasticity loss arises because optimal points from previous tasks become poor local optima for new tasks, trapping parameters during task transitions and hindering subsequent learning. We theoretically establish the equivalence between neuron dormancy and zero-gradient states, demonstrating that the absence of gradient signals is the primary driver of dormancy. Our experiments reveal that plasticity loss is highly task-specific; notably, networks with high dormancy rates in one task can achieve performance parity with randomly initialized networks when switched to a significantly different task, suggesting that the network's capacity remains intact but is inhibited by the specific optimization landscape. Furthermore, our hypothesis elucidates why parameter constraints mitigate plasticity loss by preventing deep entrenchment in local optima. Validated across diverse non-stationary scenarios, our findings provide a rigorous optimization-based framework for understanding and restoring network plasticity in complex RL domains.
tldr: The paper introduces the Optimization-Centric Plasticity (OCP) hypothesis to explain plasticity loss in deep RL due to task-specific optimization landscapes and proposes that parameter constraints can mitigate this loss. The paper validates the OCP hypothesis through experiments and provides a rigorous optimization-based framework for understanding and restoring network plasticity in complex RL domains.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了优化中心可塑性(OCP)假说，解释了深度强化学习中由于任务特定的优化环境导致的可塑性损失，并提出参数约束可以缓解这种损失。论文通过实验验证了OCP假说，并为理解和恢复复杂强化学习领域中的网络可塑性提供了一个严格的基于优化的框架。
summary_zh: 本文研究了驱动深度强化学习（RL）中可塑性丧失的根本机制，这是一个关键挑战，即神经网络丧失了适应非平稳环境的能力。虽然现有的研究通常依赖于诸如休眠神经元或有效秩等描述性指标，但这些概括性指标无法解释底层的优化动态。我们提出了以优化为中心的可塑性（OCP）假说，该假说认为可塑性丧失源于先前任务的最优点成为新任务的较差局部最优解，在任务转换期间困住参数并阻碍后续学习。我们在理论上建立了神经元休眠和零梯度状态之间的等价性，表明梯度信号的缺失是休眠的主要驱动因素。我们的实验表明，可塑性丧失具有高度的任务特异性；值得注意的是，在一个任务中具有高休眠率的网络，当切换到显著不同的任务时，可以达到与随机初始化网络相当的性能，这表明网络的容量仍然完好无损，但受到特定优化地形的抑制。此外，我们的假说阐明了为什么参数约束通过防止在局部最优解中过度固化来减轻可塑性丧失。经过在各种非平稳场景下的验证，我们的发现提供了一个严格的、基于优化的框架，用于理解和恢复复杂RL领域中的网络可塑性。

title: Revisiting Tree Search for LLMs: Gumbel and Sequential Halving for Budget-Scalable Reasoning
summary: Neural tree search is a powerful decision-making algorithm widely used in complex domains such as game playing and model-based reinforcement learning. Recent work has applied AlphaZero-style tree search to enhance the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) during inference, but we find that this approach suffers from a scaling failure: on GSM8K and Game24, accuracy drops as the search budget increases. In this paper, we present ReSCALE, an adaptation of Gumbel AlphaZero MCTS that replaces Dirichlet noise and PUCT selection with Gumbel sampling and Sequential Halving, restoring monotonic scaling without changes to the model or its training. ReSCALE reaches 58.4\% on GSM8K and 85.3\% on Game24 at budgets where the baseline degrades. Ablations confirm that Sequential Halving is the primary driver of the improvement.
tldr: The paper introduces ReSCALE, an adaptation of Gumbel AlphaZero MCTS using Gumbel sampling and Sequential Halving, to address the scaling failure of AlphaZero-style tree search with LLMs, achieving improved performance on GSM8K and Game24.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ReSCALE，一种基于Gumbel AlphaZero MCTS的改进方法，利用Gumbel采样和连续减半来解决AlphaZero风格的树搜索在LLM中存在的扩展问题，在GSM8K和Game24上获得了更好的性能。
summary_zh: 神经树搜索是一种强大的决策算法，广泛应用于博弈和基于模型的强化学习等复杂领域。最近的研究已将 AlphaZero 风格的树搜索应用于增强大型语言模型 (LLM) 在推理过程中的推理能力，但我们发现这种方法存在扩展性问题：在 GSM8K 和 Game24 上，随着搜索预算的增加，准确率会下降。在本文中，我们提出了 ReSCALE，它是 Gumbel AlphaZero MCTS 的一种改进版本，它使用 Gumbel 采样和顺序减半法取代了狄利克雷噪声和 PUCT 选择，在不更改模型或其训练的情况下恢复了单调扩展性。在基线退化的预算下，ReSCALE 在 GSM8K 上达到了 58.4% 的准确率，在 Game24 上达到了 85.3% 的准确率。消融实验证实，顺序减半法是改进的主要驱动因素。

title: SpatialFly: Geometry-Guided Representation Alignment for UAV Vision-and-Language Navigation in Urban Environments
summary: UAVs play an important role in applications such as autonomous exploration, disaster response, and infrastructure inspection. However, UAV VLN in complex 3D environments remains challenging. A key difficulty is the structural representation mismatch between 2D visual perception and the 3D trajectory decision space, which limits spatial reasoning. To this end, we propose SpatialFly, a geometry-guided spatial representation framework for UAV VLN. Operating on RGB observations without explicit 3D reconstruction, SpatialFly introduces a geometry-guided 2D representation alignment mechanism. Specifically, the geometric prior injection module injects global structural cues into 2D semantic tokens to provide scene-level geometric guidance. The geometry-aware reparameterization module then aligns 2D semantic tokens with 3D geometric tokens through cross-modal attention, followed by gated residual fusion to preserve semantic discrimination. Experimental results show that SpatialFly consistently outperforms state-of-the-art UAV VLN baselines across both seen and unseen environments, reducing NE by 4.03m and improving SR by 1.27% over the strongest baseline on the unseen Full split. Additional trajectory-level analysis shows that SpatialFly produces trajectories with better path alignment and smoother, more stable motion.
tldr: SpatialFly addresses the spatial reasoning challenges in UAV Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) by introducing a geometry-guided 2D representation alignment mechanism, leading to improved performance over state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: SpatialFly通过引入一种几何引导的2D表示对齐机制，解决了无人机视觉-语言导航（VLN）中的空间推理挑战，从而提高了优于最先进方法的性能。
summary_zh: 无人机在自主探索、灾害响应和基础设施巡检等应用中发挥着重要作用。然而，在复杂的3D环境中实现无人机视觉导航（VLN）仍然具有挑战性。一个关键难点是2D视觉感知和3D轨迹决策空间之间的结构表示不匹配，这限制了空间推理。 为此，我们提出SpatialFly，一个用于无人机视觉导航的几何引导空间表示框架。 SpatialFly在无需显式3D重建的情况下，基于RGB观测，引入了一种几何引导的2D表示对齐机制。 具体来说，几何先验注入模块将全局结构线索注入到2D语义令牌中，以提供场景级的几何引导。 然后，几何感知重参数化模块通过跨模态注意力将2D语义令牌与3D几何令牌对齐，随后进行门控残差融合以保持语义区分度。 实验结果表明， SpatialFly在已见环境和未见环境下均优于最先进的无人机视觉导航基线，在未见Full分割上，导航误差（NE）降低了4.03米，成功率（SR）提高了1.27%，超过了最强的基线。 额外的轨迹级分析表明，SpatialFly生成的轨迹具有更好的路径对齐以及更平滑、更稳定的运动。

title: KLDrive: Fine-Grained 3D Scene Reasoning for Autonomous Driving based on Knowledge Graph
summary: Autonomous driving requires reliable reasoning over fine-grained 3D scene facts. Fine-grained question answering over multi-modal driving observations provides a natural way to evaluate this capability, yet existing perception pipelines and driving-oriented large language model (LLM) methods still suffer from unreliable scene facts, hallucinations, opaque reasoning, and heavy reliance on task-specific training. We present KLDrive, the first knowledge-graph-augmented LLM reasoning framework for fine-grained question answering in autonomous driving. KLDrive addresses this problem through designing two tightly coupled components: an energy-based scene fact construction module that consolidates multi-source evidence into a reliable scene knowledge graph, and an LLM agent that performs fact-grounded reasoning over a constrained action space under explicit structural constraints. By combining structured prompting with few-shot in-context exemplars, the framework adapts to diverse reasoning tasks without heavy task-specific fine-tuning. Experiments on two large-scale autonomous-driving QA benchmarks show that KLDrive outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods, achieving the best overall accuracy of 65.04% on NuScenes-QA and the best SPICE score of 42.45 on GVQA. On counting, the most challenging factual reasoning task, it improves over the strongest baseline by 46.01 percentage points, demonstrating substantially reduced hallucinations and the benefit of coupling reliable scene fact construction with explicit reasoning.
tldr: The paper introduces KLDrive, a knowledge-graph-augmented LLM framework for fine-grained 3D scene reasoning in autonomous driving, which improves performance on question answering tasks by using a reliable scene knowledge graph and fact-grounded reasoning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 KLDrive 的知识图谱增强的 LLM 框架，用于自动驾驶中细粒度的 3D 场景推理。它通过使用可靠的场景知识图谱和基于事实的推理，提高了在问答任务上的性能。
summary_zh: 自主驾驶需要在细粒度的3D场景事实之上进行可靠推理。基于多模态驾驶观察的细粒度问答为评估这种能力提供了一种自然的方式，然而现有的感知流水线和面向驾驶的大型语言模型（LLM）方法仍然存在不可靠的场景事实、幻觉、不透明的推理以及对特定任务训练的严重依赖等问题。我们提出了KLDrive，这是首个用于自主驾驶中细粒度问答的知识图谱增强型LLM推理框架。KLDrive通过设计两个紧密耦合的组件来解决这个问题：一个基于能量的场景事实构建模块，该模块将多源证据整合到可靠的场景知识图谱中；以及一个LLM代理，该代理在显式结构约束下，在受约束的动作空间内对基于事实的数据进行推理。通过将结构化提示与少量样本的上下文示例相结合，该框架能够适应各种推理任务，而无需大量的特定任务微调。在两个大规模自主驾驶QA基准测试上的实验表明，KLDrive优于先前的最先进方法，在NuScenes-QA上实现了65.04%的最佳总体准确率，在GVQA上实现了42.45的最佳SPICE评分。在最具挑战性的事实推理任务——计数方面，它比最强的基线提高了46.01个百分点，表明显著减少了幻觉，并证明了将可靠的场景事实构建与显式推理相结合的优势。

title: Detection of adversarial intent in Human-AI teams using LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in human-AI teams as support agents for complex tasks such as information retrieval, programming, and decision-making assistance. While these agents' autonomy and contextual knowledge enables them to be useful, it also exposes them to a broad range of attacks, including data poisoning, prompt injection, and even prompt engineering. Through these attack vectors, malicious actors can manipulate an LLM agent to provide harmful information, potentially manipulating human agents to make harmful decisions. While prior work has focused on LLMs as attack targets or adversarial actors, this paper studies their potential role as defensive supervisors within mixed human-AI teams. Using a dataset consisting of multi-party conversations and decisions for a real human-AI team over a 25 round horizon, we formulate the problem of malicious behavior detection from interaction traces. We find that LLMs are capable of identifying malicious behavior in real-time, and without task-specific information, indicating the potential for task-agnostic defense. Moreover, we find that the malicious behavior of interest is not easily identified using simple heuristics, further suggesting the introduction of LLM defenders could render human teams more robust to certain classes of attack.
tldr: This paper explores the ability of LLMs to detect adversarial intent within human-AI teams by analyzing interaction traces, demonstrating their potential as task-agnostic defenders against malicious behavior.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了大型语言模型通过分析交互轨迹来检测人机团队中对抗意图的能力，展示了它们作为针对恶意行为的任务无关防御者的潜力。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)越来越多地被部署在人机团队中，作为信息检索、编程和决策辅助等复杂任务的支持代理。虽然这些代理的自主性和上下文知识使其能够发挥作用，但也使其暴露于广泛的攻击之下，包括数据投毒、提示注入甚至提示工程。通过这些攻击向量，恶意行为者可以操纵LLM代理提供有害信息，从而可能操纵人类代理做出有害的决策。虽然先前的工作主要关注LLM作为攻击目标或对抗性行为者，但本文研究了它们在混合人机团队中作为防御性监督者的潜在作用。我们使用一个包含真实人机团队在25轮周期内的多方对话和决策的数据集，将恶意行为检测问题形式化为从交互轨迹中提取信息。我们发现LLM能够实时识别恶意行为，并且无需特定于任务的信息，这表明存在与任务无关的防御潜力。此外，我们发现感兴趣的恶意行为不容易通过简单的启发式方法识别，进一步表明引入LLM防御者可以使人类团队对某些类型的攻击更具鲁棒性。

title: NoOVD: Novel Category Discovery and Embedding for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
summary: Despite the remarkable progress in open-vocabulary object detection (OVD), a significant gap remains between the training and testing phases. During training, the RPN and RoI heads often misclassify unlabeled novel-category objects as background, causing some proposals to be prematurely filtered out by the RPN while others are further misclassified by the RoI head. During testing, these proposals again receive low scores and are removed in post-processing, leading to a significant drop in recall and ultimately weakening novel-category detection performance.To address these issues, we propose a novel training framework-NoOVD-which innovatively integrates a self-distillation mechanism grounded in the knowledge of frozen vision-language models (VLMs). Specifically, we design K-FPN, which leverages the pretrained knowledge of VLMs to guide the model in discovering novel-category objects and facilitates knowledge distillation-without requiring additional data-thus preventing forced alignment of novel objects with background.Additionally, we introduce R-RPN, which adjusts the confidence scores of proposals during inference to improve the recall of novel-category objects. Cross-dataset evaluations on OV-LVIS, OV-COCO, and Objects365 demonstrate that our approach consistently achieves superior performance across multiple metrics.
tldr: The paper introduces NoOVD, a novel training framework for open-vocabulary object detection that uses self-distillation and knowledge from frozen vision-language models to improve novel category detection performance by addressing misclassification issues of novel objects as background during training and inference.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了NoOVD，一种用于开放词汇目标检测的新型训练框架，它利用自蒸馏和冻结的视觉-语言模型的知识，通过解决训练和推理过程中将新类别对象错误分类为背景的问题，从而提高新类别检测性能。
summary_zh: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）取得了显著进展，但训练阶段和测试阶段之间仍然存在显著差距。在训练过程中，RPN和RoI头通常会将未标注的新类别对象错误分类为背景，导致一些候选区域提前被RPN过滤掉，而另一些则被RoI头进一步误分类。在测试过程中，这些候选区域再次获得低分并在后处理中被移除，导致召回率显著下降，最终削弱了新类别的检测性能。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新的训练框架——NoOVD——它创新性地集成了基于冻结的视觉-语言模型（VLM）知识的自蒸馏机制。具体来说，我们设计了K-FPN，它利用VLM的预训练知识来引导模型发现新类别对象，并促进无需额外数据的知识蒸馏，从而防止新类别对象被迫与背景对齐。此外，我们引入了R-RPN，它在推理过程中调整候选区域的置信度分数，以提高新类别对象的召回率。在OV-LVIS、OV-COCO和Objects365上的跨数据集评估表明，我们的方法在多个指标上始终如一地实现了卓越的性能。

title: FluidWorld: Reaction-Diffusion Dynamics as a Predictive Substrate for World Models
summary: World models learn to predict future states of an environment, enabling planning and mental simulation. Current approaches default to Transformer-based predictors operating in learned latent spaces. This comes at a cost: O(N^2) computation and no explicit spatial inductive bias. This paper asks a foundational question: is self-attention necessary for predictive world modeling, or can alternative computational substrates achieve comparable or superior results? I introduce FluidWorld, a proof-of-concept world model whose predictive dynamics are governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) of reaction-diffusion type. Instead of using a separate neural network predictor, the PDE integration itself produces the future state prediction. In a strictly parameter-matched three-way ablation on unconditional UCF-101 video prediction (64x64, ~800K parameters, identical encoder, decoder, losses, and data), FluidWorld is compared against both a Transformer baseline (self-attention) and a ConvLSTM baseline (convolutional recurrence). While all three models converge to comparable single-step prediction loss, FluidWorld achieves 2x lower reconstruction error, produces representations with 10-15% higher spatial structure preservation and 18-25% more effective dimensionality, and critically maintains coherent multi-step rollouts where both baselines degrade rapidly. All experiments were conducted on a single consumer-grade PC (Intel Core i5, NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti), without any large-scale compute. These results establish that PDE-based dynamics, which natively provide O(N) spatial complexity, adaptive computation, and global spatial coherence through diffusion, are a viable and parameter-efficient alternative to both attention and convolutional recurrence for world modeling.
tldr: The paper introduces FluidWorld, a world model that uses reaction-diffusion PDEs for predictive dynamics, demonstrating comparable or superior performance to Transformer and ConvLSTM baselines on UCF-101 video prediction while offering O(N) spatial complexity and improved spatial coherence.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FluidWorld，一种使用反应扩散偏微分方程进行预测动力学的世界模型。它在UCF-101视频预测上表现出与Transformer和ConvLSTM基线相当或更优越的性能，同时提供O(N)的空间复杂度和改进的空间连贯性。
summary_zh: 世界模型学习预测环境的未来状态，从而实现规划和心理模拟。目前的方法默认使用基于Transformer的预测器在学习到的潜在空间中运行。这带来了代价：O(N^2)的计算复杂度和缺乏显式的空间归纳偏置。本文提出了一个基础性的问题：自注意力对于预测性世界建模是必要的吗？或者说，其他的计算基底能否达到相当或更优的结果？我引入了FluidWorld，一个概念验证型的世界模型，其预测动态由反应扩散类型的偏微分方程（PDEs）控制。与其使用单独的神经网络预测器，PDE积分本身就产生未来状态的预测。在一个严格参数匹配的三方消融研究中，针对无条件UCF-101视频预测（64x64，约80万参数，相同的编码器、解码器、损失函数和数据），FluidWorld与Transformer基线（自注意力）和ConvLSTM基线（卷积循环）进行了比较。虽然所有三个模型都收敛到相当的单步预测损失，但FluidWorld实现了低2倍的重建误差，产生的表征具有更高的空间结构保持（10-15%）和更有效的维度（18-25%），并且关键地保持了连贯的多步展开，而两个基线模型都迅速退化。所有实验都在一台消费级PC上进行（Intel Core i5, NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti），没有任何大规模计算。这些结果表明，基于PDE的动态，其本地提供O(N)的空间复杂度、自适应计算以及通过扩散实现的全局空间连贯性，是世界建模中注意力和卷积循环的一种可行且参数高效的替代方案。

title: ResPrune: Text-Conditioned Subspace Reconstruction for Visual Token Pruning in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) rely on dense visual tokens to capture fine-grained visual information, but processing all these tokens incurs substantial computational and memory overhead during inference. To address this issue, we propose ResPrune, a training-free visual token pruning framework that enables efficient LVLM inference by selecting a compact yet informative subset of visual tokens. ResPrune formulates visual token pruning as a subspace reconstruction problem and employs a greedy subspace expansion strategy guided by residual energy, allowing it to preserve the geometric structure of the original visual token space. To further incorporate cross modal alignment, the selection process is conditioned on textual relevance, encouraging the retention of tokens that are both informative and instruction-relevant. The proposed method is lightweight and model-agnostic, and can be seamlessly integrated into existing LVLM pipelines without retraining or architectural modifications. Extensive experiments on multiple LVLM backbones, including LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, and Qwen2.5-VL, demonstrate that ResPrune consistently outperforms existing pruning approaches across a wide range of benchmarks, while achieving effective reductions in computation, memory consumption, and inference latency.
tldr: The paper introduces ResPrune, a training-free visual token pruning method for LVLMs that uses subspace reconstruction and text conditioning to improve efficiency without retraining, demonstrating performance gains on several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ResPrune的视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)的免训练视觉token剪枝方法。该方法使用子空间重构和文本条件进行处理，从而提高效率，而无需重新训练，并在多个基准测试中表现出性能提升。
summary_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）依赖于密集的视觉标记来捕捉细粒度的视觉信息，但在推理过程中处理所有这些标记会产生大量的计算和内存开销。为了解决这个问题，我们提出ResPrune，一种无需训练的视觉标记剪枝框架，通过选择一个紧凑且信息丰富的视觉标记子集来实现高效的LVLM推理。ResPrune将视觉标记剪枝形式化为一个子空间重构问题，并采用残差能量引导的贪婪子空间扩展策略，从而保持原始视觉标记空间的几何结构。为了进一步整合跨模态对齐，选择过程以文本相关性为条件，鼓励保留既信息丰富又与指令相关的标记。所提出的方法轻量且模型无关，可以无缝集成到现有的LVLM流程中，无需重新训练或架构修改。在多个LVLM骨干网络上的大量实验，包括LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT和Qwen2.5-VL，表明ResPrune在各种基准测试中始终优于现有的剪枝方法，同时有效减少了计算量、内存消耗和推理延迟。

title: Anatomical Prior-Driven Framework for Autonomous Robotic Cardiac Ultrasound Standard View Acquisition
summary: Cardiac ultrasound diagnosis is critical for cardiovascular disease assessment, but acquiring standard views remains highly operator-dependent. Existing medical segmentation models often yield anatomically inconsistent results in images with poor textural differentiation between distinct feature classes, while autonomous probe adjustment methods either rely on simplistic heuristic rules or black-box learning. To address these issues, our study proposed an anatomical prior (AP)-driven framework integrating cardiac structure segmentation and autonomous probe adjustment for standard view acquisition. A YOLO-based multi-class segmentation model augmented by a spatial-relation graph (SRG) module is designed to embed AP into the feature pyramid. Quantifiable anatomical features of standard views are extracted. Their priors are fitted to Gaussian distributions to construct probabilistic APs. The probe adjustment process of robotic ultrasound scanning is formalized as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem, with the RL state built from real-time anatomical features and the reward reflecting the AP matching. Experiments validate the efficacy of the framework. The SRG-YOLOv11s improves mAP50 by 11.3% and mIoU by 6.8% on the Special Case dataset, while the RL agent achieves a 92.5% success rate in simulation and 86.7% in phantom experiments.
tldr: This paper presents a framework for autonomous robotic cardiac ultrasound standard view acquisition, using a YOLO-based segmentation model with spatial-relation graphs and reinforcement learning for probe adjustment based on anatomical priors.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个用于自主机器人心脏超声标准视图获取的框架，该框架使用基于YOLO的分割模型和空间关系图，并结合强化学习，根据解剖先验进行探头调整。
summary_zh: 心脏超声诊断对于心血管疾病评估至关重要，但获取标准切面需要高度依赖操作者。现有的医学分割模型在不同特征类别之间纹理区分度较差的图像中，常常产生解剖学上不一致的结果，而自主探头调整方法要么依赖于简化的启发式规则，要么依赖于黑盒学习。为了解决这些问题，我们的研究提出了一种基于解剖学先验（AP）驱动的框架，整合了心脏结构分割和自主探头调整，用于标准切面获取。设计了一个基于YOLO的多类别分割模型，并用空间关系图（SRG）模块进行增强，以将AP嵌入到特征金字塔中。提取标准切面的可量化解剖学特征，将其先验拟合为高斯分布，以构建概率AP。机器人超声扫描的探头调整过程被形式化为一个强化学习（RL）问题，RL状态由实时解剖学特征构建，奖励反映了AP的匹配度。实验验证了该框架的有效性。SRG-YOLOv11s在特殊案例数据集上将mAP50提高了11.3%，mIoU提高了6.8%，而RL智能体在模拟实验中达到了92.5%的成功率，在体模实验中达到了86.7%的成功率。

title: VisFly-Lab: Unified Differentiable Framework for First-Order Reinforcement Learning of Quadrotor Control
summary: First-order reinforcement learning with differentiable simulation is promising for quadrotor control, but practical progress remains fragmented across task-specific settings. To support more systematic development and evaluation, we present a unified differentiable framework for multi-task quadrotor control. The framework is wrapped, extensible, and equipped with deployment-oriented dynamics, providing a common interface across four representative tasks: hovering, tracking, landing, and racing. We also present the suite of first-order learning algorithms, where we identify two practical bottlenecks of standard first-order training: limited state coverage caused by horizon initialization and gradient bias caused by partially non-differentiable rewards. To address these issues, we propose Amended Backpropagation Through Time (ABPT), which combines differentiable rollout optimization, a value-based auxiliary objective, and visited-state initialization to improve training robustness. Experimental results show that ABPT yields the clearest gains in tasks with partially non-differentiable rewards, while remaining competitive in fully differentiable settings. We further provide proof-of-concept real-world deployments showing initial transferability of policies learned in the proposed framework beyond simulation.
tldr: The paper presents VisFly-Lab, a unified differentiable framework for first-order reinforcement learning of quadrotor control, addressing training robustness issues with Amended Backpropagation Through Time (ABPT) and demonstrating initial real-world transferability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了VisFly-Lab，一个用于四旋翼控制的一阶强化学习的统一可微框架。它通过修正后的时间反向传播（ABPT）解决训练鲁棒性问题，并展示了在真实世界中的初步迁移能力。
summary_zh: 使用可微分仿真的（英语）一阶强化学习在四旋翼飞行器控制方面展现出潜力，但实际进展仍然零散分布在特定任务设置中。为了支持更系统的开发和评估，我们提出了一个用于多任务四旋翼飞行器控制的统一可微分框架。 该框架是封装的、可扩展的，并且配备了面向部署的动力学模型，为四个代表性任务提供了通用接口：悬停、跟踪、着陆和竞速。 我们还提出了一套一阶学习算法，并在此识别了标准一阶训练的两个实际瓶颈：由时间范围初始化导致的状态覆盖范围有限，以及由部分不可微分奖励导致的梯度偏差。 为了解决这些问题，我们提出了修正型时间反向传播（ABPT），它结合了可微分rollout优化、基于价值的辅助目标和访问状态初始化，以提高训练的鲁棒性。 实验结果表明，ABPT在具有部分不可微分奖励的任务中产生了最明显的收益，同时在完全可微分的设置中仍然具有竞争力。 我们进一步提供了一些概念验证的真实世界部署，展示了在该框架中学习到的策略在模拟之外的初步可迁移性。

title: Geometrically Plausible Object Pose Refinement using Differentiable Simulation
summary: State-of-the-art object pose estimation methods are prone to generating geometrically infeasible pose hypotheses. This problem is prevalent in dexterous manipulation, where estimated poses often intersect with the robotic hand or are not lying on a support surface. We propose a multi-modal pose refinement approach that combines differentiable physics simulation, differentiable rendering and visuo-tactile sensing to optimize object poses for both spatial accuracy and physical consistency. Simulated experiments show that our approach reduces the intersection volume error between the object and robotic hand by 73\% when the initial estimate is accurate and by over 87\% under high initial uncertainty, significantly outperforming standard ICP-based baselines. Furthermore, the improvement in geometric plausibility is accompanied by a concurrent reduction in translation and orientation errors. Achieving pose estimation that is grounded in physical reality while remaining faithful to multi-modal sensor inputs is a critical step toward robust in-hand manipulation.
tldr: This paper proposes a new method for object pose refinement using differentiable physics simulation, differentiable rendering and visuo-tactile sensing to ensure geometric plausibility, particularly in robotic manipulation scenarios, outperforming ICP baselines. It improves pose accuracy and reduces intersections with the robot hand.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的物体姿态优化方法，使用可微物理仿真、可微渲染和视觉触觉传感，以确保几何合理性，尤其是在机器人操作场景中，优于ICP基线。它提高了姿态精度并减少了与机器人手的交叉。
summary_zh: 目前最先进的物体姿态估计方法容易产生几何上不可行的姿态假设。这个问题在灵巧操作中尤为普遍，估计的姿态经常与机械手发生干涉，或者没有位于支撑面上。我们提出了一种多模态姿态优化方法，该方法结合了可微分物理模拟、可微分渲染和视觉触觉感知，以优化物体的空间精度和物理一致性。模拟实验表明，当初始估计准确时，我们的方法将物体与机械手之间的干涉体积误差降低了73％，在高初始不确定性下则降低了87％以上，显著优于基于标准ICP的基线方法。此外，几何合理性的提升伴随着平移和方向误差的同步降低。实现基于物理现实并忠实于多模态传感器输入的姿态估计，是实现稳健的手内操作的关键一步。

title: Improving Coherence and Persistence in Agentic AI for System Optimization
summary:
Designing high-performance system heuristics is a creative, iterative process requiring experts to form hypotheses and execute multi-step conceptual shifts. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in automating this loop, they struggle with complex system problems due to two critical failure modes: evolutionary neighborhood bias and the coherence ceiling. Evolutionary methods often remain trapped in local optima by relying on scalar benchmark scores, failing when coordinated multi-step changes are required. Conversely, existing agentic frameworks suffer from context degradation over long horizons or fail to accumulate knowledge across independent runs.
  We present Engram, an agentic researcher architecture that addresses these limitations by decoupling long-horizon exploration from the constraints of a single context window. Engram organizes exploration into a sequence of agents that iteratively design, test, and analyze mechanisms. At the conclusion of each run, an agent stores code snapshots, logs, and results in a persistent Archive and distills high-level modeling insights into a compact, persistent Research Digest. Subsequent agents then begin with a fresh context window, reading the Research Digest to build on prior discoveries.
  We find that Engram exhibits superior performance across diverse domains including multi-cloud multicast, LLM inference request routing, and optimizing KV cache reuse in databases with natural language queries.
tldr: The paper introduces Engram, an agentic researcher architecture that overcomes limitations in existing LLM-based system optimization by decoupling long-horizon exploration and maintaining a persistent knowledge archive, demonstrating superior performance across several domains.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 Engram 的 agentic 研究架构，它通过解耦长时程探索并维护持久的知识档案，克服了现有基于 LLM 的系统优化方法的局限性，并在多个领域展示了卓越的性能。
summary_zh:
设计高性能系统启发式算法是一个创造性的、迭代的过程，需要专家提出假设并执行多步概念转变。虽然大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化这个循环流程方面展现出潜力，但由于两种关键的失效模式，它们在处理复杂的系统问题时会遇到困难：进化的邻域偏差和一致性上限。进化方法通常依赖于标量基准评分而陷入局部最优，当需要协调的多步变更时就会失效。相反，现有的代理框架要么在长时程内遭受上下文降解，要么无法在独立运行中积累知识。

我们提出了Engram，一种代理研究员架构，通过将长时程探索从单个上下文窗口的约束中解耦来解决这些局限性。Engram 将探索组织成一系列迭代地设计、测试和分析机制的代理。在每次运行结束时，代理会将代码快照、日志和结果存储在一个持久化的存档中，并将高级建模见解提炼成一个紧凑的、持久化的研究摘要。后续的代理会从一个新的上下文窗口开始，阅读研究摘要以构建在先前发现的基础上。

我们发现Engram在包括多云组播、LLM推理请求路由以及优化数据库中带自然语言查询的KV缓存复用等多个领域都表现出卓越的性能。

title: LongCat-Flash-Prover: Advancing Native Formal Reasoning via Agentic Tool-Integrated Reinforcement Learning
summary: We introduce LongCat-Flash-Prover, a flagship 560-billion-parameter open-source Mixture-of- Experts (MoE) model that advances Native Formal Reasoning in Lean4 through agentic tool-integrated reasoning (TIR). We decompose the native formal reasoning task into three independent formal capabilities, i.e., auto-formalization, sketching, and proving. To facilitate these capabilities, we propose a Hybrid-Experts Iteration Framework to expand high-quality task trajectories, including generating a formal statement based on a given informal problem, producing a whole-proof directly from the statement, or a lemma-style sketch. During agentic RL, we present a Hierarchical Importance Sampling Policy Optimization (HisPO) algorithm, which aims to stabilize the MoE model training on such long-horizon tasks. It employs a gradient masking strategy that accounts for the policy staleness and the inherent train-inference engine discrepancies at both sequence and token levels. Additionally, we also incorporate theorem consistency and legality detection mechanisms to eliminate reward hacking issues. Extensive evaluations show that our LongCat-Flash-Prover sets a new state-of-the-art for open-weights models in both auto-formalization and theorem proving. Demonstrating remarkable sample efficiency, it achieves a 97.1% pass rate on MiniF2F-Test using only 72 inference budget per problem. On more challenging benchmarks, it solves 70.8% of ProverBench and 41.5% of PutnamBench with no more than 220 attempts per problem, significantly outperforming existing open-weights baselines.
tldr: LongCat-Flash-Prover, a 560B parameter MoE model, achieves state-of-the-art results in native formal reasoning using a novel agentic tool-integrated reinforcement learning approach with hierarchical importance sampling and consistency checks.
tldr_zh: LongCat-Flash-Prover是一个拥有5600亿参数的MoE模型，通过一种新颖的工具集成强化学习方法，结合分层重要性采样和一致性检查，在原生形式推理方面达到了最先进的水平。
summary_zh: 我们推出了LongCat-Flash-Prover，一个具有5600亿参数的旗舰开源混合专家(MoE)模型，它通过自主代理工具集成推理(TIR)推进Lean4中的原生形式化推理。我们将原生形式化推理任务分解为三个独立的形式化能力，即自动形式化、草图构建和证明。为了促进这些能力，我们提出了一个混合专家迭代框架，以扩展高质量的任务轨迹，包括根据给定的非形式化问题生成形式化陈述，直接从陈述产生完整证明，或类似引理的草图。在自主代理强化学习过程中，我们提出了一种分层重要性采样策略优化(HisPO)算法，旨在稳定MoE模型在如此长周期任务上的训练。它采用梯度掩蔽策略，该策略同时考虑了序列级别和Token级别上的策略滞后性和固有的训练-推理引擎差异。此外，我们还结合了定理一致性和合法性检测机制，以消除奖励作弊问题。广泛的评估表明，我们的LongCat-Flash-Prover在自动形式化和定理证明方面为开源权重模型树立了新的最先进水平。它展示了卓越的样本效率，仅使用每个问题72次推理预算，就在MiniF2F-Test上达到了97.1%的通过率。在更具挑战性的基准测试中，它解决了ProverBench的70.8%和PutnamBench的41.5%，每个问题不超过220次尝试，显著优于现有的开源权重基线。

title: The Intelligent Disobedience Game: Formulating Disobedience in Stackelberg Games and Markov Decision Processes
summary: In shared autonomy, a critical tension arises when an automated assistant must choose between obeying a human's instruction and deliberately overriding it to prevent harm. This safety-critical behavior is known as intelligent disobedience. To formalize this dynamic, this paper introduces the Intelligent Disobedience Game (IDG), a sequential game-theoretic framework based on Stackelberg games that models the interaction between a human leader and an assistive follower operating under asymmetric information. It characterizes optimal strategies for both agents across multi-step scenarios, identifying strategic phenomena such as ``safety traps,'' where the system indefinitely avoids harm but fails to achieve the human's goal. The IDG provides a needed mathematical foundation that enables both the algorithmic development of agents that can learn safe non-compliance and the empirical study of how humans perceive and trust disobedient AI. The paper further translates the IDG into a shared control Multi-Agent Markov Decision Process representation, forming a compact computational testbed for training reinforcement learning agents.
tldr: This paper introduces a game-theoretic framework, the Intelligent Disobedience Game (IDG), to model the interaction between humans and assistive AI in shared autonomy scenarios where the AI must decide whether to obey or override human instructions to prevent harm, and translates this into a multi-agent MDP for reinforcement learning applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个博弈论框架——智能不服从博弈（IDG），用于建模共享自主场景中人与辅助人工智能之间的交互。在该场景中，人工智能必须决定是服从还是否决人类的指令以防止伤害，并将此转化为多智能体MDP，用于强化学习应用。
summary_zh: 在共享自主中，当自动化助手必须在服从人类指令和为了防止伤害而刻意违背指令之间做出选择时，会产生一个关键的张力。这种安全攸关的行为被称为智能不服从。为了形式化这种动态，本文引入了智能不服从博弈 (IDG)，一个基于斯塔克尔伯格博弈的序贯博弈论框架，用于建模在非对称信息下运行的人类领导者和辅助追随者之间的交互。它描述了多个步骤场景下双方智能体的最优策略，识别出诸如“安全陷阱”之类的策略现象，即系统无限期地避免了伤害，但未能实现人类的目标。IDG 提供了一个必要的数学基础，它能够实现能够学习安全非顺从性的智能体的算法开发，以及人类如何感知和信任不服从的人工智能的经验研究。本文进一步将 IDG 转化为共享控制的多智能体马尔可夫决策过程表示，形成了一个紧凑的计算测试平台，用于训练强化学习智能体。

title: Cyber Deception for Mission Surveillance via Hypergame-Theoretic Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are valuable for mission-critical systems like surveillance, rescue, or delivery. Not surprisingly, such systems attract cyberattacks, including Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks to overwhelm the resources of mission drones (MDs). How can we defend UAV mission systems against DoS attacks? We adopt cyber deception as a defense strategy, in which honey drones (HDs) are proposed to bait and divert attacks. The attack and deceptive defense hinge upon radio signal strength: The attacker selects victim MDs based on their signals, and HDs attract the attacker from afar by emitting stronger signals, despite this reducing battery life. We formulate an optimization problem for the attacker and defender to identify their respective strategies for maximizing mission performance while minimizing energy consumption. To address this problem, we propose a novel approach, called HT-DRL. HT-DRL identifies optimal solutions without a long learning convergence time by taking the solutions of hypergame theory into the neural network of deep reinforcement learning. This achieves a systematic way to intelligently deceive attackers. We analyze the performance of diverse defense mechanisms under different attack strategies. Further, the HT-DRL-based HD approach outperforms existing non-HD counterparts up to two times better in mission performance while incurring low energy consumption.
tldr: This paper proposes a hypergame-theoretic deep reinforcement learning (HT-DRL) approach for cyber deception in UAV mission systems, using honey drones to defend against DoS attacks, showing improved mission performance and energy consumption compared to non-HD counterparts.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种hypergame理论的深度强化学习(HT-DRL)方法，用于无人机任务系统中的网络欺骗，利用蜜罐无人机防御拒绝服务(DoS)攻击，与非蜜罐无人机相比，任务性能和能源消耗都有所提高。
summary_zh: 无人机（UAV）在监视、救援或输送等关键任务系统中具有重要价值。不出所料，这类系统会吸引网络攻击，包括拒绝服务（DoS）攻击，以压垮任务无人机（MD）的资源。我们该如何防御无人机任务系统免受DoS攻击？我们采用网络欺骗作为防御策略，其中提出使用蜜罐无人机（HD）来诱饵和转移攻击。攻击和欺骗性防御依赖于无线电信号强度：攻击者基于其信号选择受害MD，而HD通过发射更强的信号从远处吸引攻击者，尽管这会缩短电池寿命。我们为攻击者和防御者制定了一个优化问题，以确定他们各自的策略，从而在最小化能量消耗的同时最大化任务性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为HT-DRL的新方法。HT-DRL通过将超博弈论的解决方案纳入深度强化学习的神经网络中，从而在不花费过长学习收敛时间的情况下识别出最优解。这实现了一种系统化方式来智能地欺骗攻击者。我们分析了不同攻击策略下各种防御机制的性能。此外，基于HT-DRL的HD方法在任务性能方面比现有的非HD方法优越高达两倍，同时消耗较低的能量。

title: Before the Tool Call: Deterministic Pre-Action Authorization for Autonomous AI Agents
summary:
AI agents today have passwords but no permission slips. They execute tool calls (fund transfers, database queries, shell commands, sub-agent delegation) with no standard mechanism to enforce authorization before the action executes. Current safety architectures rely on model alignment (probabilistic, training-time) and post-hoc evaluation (retrospective, batch). Neither provides deterministic, policy-based enforcement at the individual tool call level.
  We characterize this gap as the pre-action authorization problem and present the Open Agent Passport (OAP), an open specification and reference implementation that intercepts tool calls synchronously before execution, evaluates them against a declarative policy, and produces a cryptographically signed audit record. OAP enforces authorization decisions in a measured median of 53 ms (N=1,000). In a live adversarial testbed (4,437 authorization decisions across 1,151 sessions, $5,000 bounty), social engineering succeeded against the model 74.6% of the time under a permissive policy; under a restrictive OAP policy, a comparable population of attackers achieved a 0% success rate across 879 attempts.
  We distinguish pre-action authorization from sandboxed execution (contains blast radius but does not prevent unauthorized actions) and model-based screening (probabilistic), and show they are complementary. The same infrastructure that enforces security constraints (spending limits, capability scoping) also enforces quality gates, operational contracts, and compliance controls. The specification is released under Apache 2.0 (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18901596).
tldr: The paper introduces Open Agent Passport (OAP), a deterministic, policy-based authorization mechanism for AI agent tool calls, addressing a critical security gap by enforcing permissions before execution and providing cryptographic audit records.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Open Agent Passport (OAP)，一种确定性的、基于策略的AI代理工具调用授权机制。它通过在执行前强制执行权限并提供加密审计记录，解决了当前AI代理安全的一个关键缺口。
summary_zh:
现今的AI智能体拥有密码，但缺少许可单。它们执行工具调用（资金转移、数据库查询、shell命令、子智能体委托）时，并没有在执行操作前强制授权的标准机制。当前的安全性架构依赖于模型对齐（概率性的，训练时）和事后评估（回顾性的，批量的）。两者都不能在单个工具调用层面上提供确定性的、基于策略的强制执行。

我们定义此差距为动作前授权问题，并提出开放智能体通行证（OAP），这是一个开放规范和参考实现，可在执行前同步拦截工具调用，根据声明性策略对其进行评估，并生成加密签名的审计记录。OAP强制执行授权决策的中位数为53毫秒（N=1,000）。在一个实时的对抗性测试平台（横跨1,151个会话的4,437个授权决策，$5,000赏金）中，在宽松策略下，社会工程攻击对模型成功率达到74.6%；在严格的OAP策略下，一组相当的攻击者在879次尝试中成功率为0%。

我们区分了动作前授权与沙箱执行（限制了爆炸半径但不能阻止未经授权的动作）和基于模型的筛选（概率性的），并表明它们是互补的。强制执行安全约束（消费限制、能力范围界定）的相同基础设施也可以强制执行质量门、运营合同和合规控制。该规范以 Apache 2.0 许可证发布（DOI：10.5281/zenodo.18901596）。

title: AC4A: Access Control for Agents
summary:
Large Language Model (LLM) agents combine the chat interaction capabilities of LLMs with the power to interact with external tools and APIs. This enables them to perform complex tasks and act autonomously to achieve user goals. However, current agent systems operate on an all-or-nothing basis: an agent either has full access to an API's capabilities and a web page's content, or it has no access at all. This coarse-grained approach forces users to trust agents with more capabilities than they actually need for a given task.
  In this paper, we introduce AC4A, an access control framework for agents. As agents become more capable and autonomous, users need a way to limit what APIs or portions of web pages these agents can access, eliminating the need to trust them with everything an API or web page allows. Our goal with AC4A is to provide a framework for defining permissions that lets agents access only the resources they are authorized to access. AC4A works across both API-based and browser-based agents. It does not prescribe what permissions should be, but offers a flexible way to define and enforce them, making it practical for real-world systems.
  AC4A works by creating permissions granting access to resources, drawing inspiration from established access control frameworks like the one for the Unix file system. Applications define their resources as hierarchies and provide a way to compute the necessary permissions at runtime needed for successful resource access. We demonstrate the usefulness of AC4A in enforcing permissions over real-world APIs and web pages through case studies. The source code of AC4A is available at https://github.com/reSHARMA/AC4A
tldr: The paper introduces AC4A, an access control framework for LLM agents that allows for fine-grained permission management for API and web page access, addressing the all-or-nothing approach of current agent systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AC4A，一个LLM代理的访问控制框架，允许精细化地管理API和网页访问权限，解决了当前代理系统非黑即白的访问权限问题。
summary_zh:
大型语言模型(LLM)智能体结合了LLM的聊天交互能力与和外部工具及API交互的能力。这使其能够执行复杂的任务并自主行动以实现用户目标。然而，当前的智能体系统以非此即彼的方式运行：一个智能体要么完全访问API的能力和网页内容，要么完全无法访问。这种粗粒度的方法迫使用户信任智能体，赋予其超出特定任务实际需要的权限。

  本文介绍了一种针对智能体的访问控制框架AC4A。随着智能体变得更加强大和自主，用户需要一种方法来限制这些智能体可以访问哪些API或网页的哪些部分，从而消除对API或网页允许的一切内容的信任需求。我们的目标是使用AC4A提供一个定义权限的框架，使智能体只能访问其被授权访问的资源。AC4A适用于基于API和基于浏览器的智能体。它不规定应该有哪些权限，而是提供了一种灵活的方式来定义和实施这些权限，使其在实际系统中具有实用性。

  AC4A通过创建授予资源访问权限的许可来工作，其灵感来自诸如Unix文件系统之类的已建立的访问控制框架。应用程序将其资源定义为层次结构，并提供一种在运行时计算成功访问资源所需的必要权限的方法。我们通过案例研究证明了AC4A在强制执行对真实API和网页的权限方面的作用。AC4A的源代码可在https://github.com/reSHARMA/AC4A 获取。

title: Profit is the Red Team: Stress-Testing Agents in Strategic Economic Interactions
summary: As agentic systems move into real-world deployments, their decisions increasingly depend on external inputs such as retrieved content, tool outputs, and information provided by other actors. When these inputs can be strategically shaped by adversaries, the relevant security risk extends beyond a fixed library of prompt attacks to adaptive strategies that steer agents toward unfavorable outcomes. We propose profit-driven red teaming, a stress-testing protocol that replaces handcrafted attacks with a learned opponent trained to maximize its profit using only scalar outcome feedback. The protocol requires no LLM-as-judge scoring, attack labels, or attack taxonomy, and is designed for structured settings with auditable outcomes. We instantiate it in a lean arena of four canonical economic interactions, which provide a controlled testbed for adaptive exploitability. In controlled experiments, agents that appear strong against static baselines become consistently exploitable under profit-optimized pressure, and the learned opponent discovers probing, anchoring, and deceptive commitments without explicit instruction. We then distill exploit episodes into concise prompt rules for the agent, which make most previously observed failures ineffective and substantially improve target performance. These results suggest that profit-driven red-team data can provide a practical route to improving robustness in structured agent settings with auditable outcomes.
tldr: The paper introduces a profit-driven red teaming protocol for stress-testing agents in strategic economic interactions, demonstrating increased exploitability compared to static baselines and showcasing the effectiveness of distilled prompt rules in improving robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种利润驱动的红队测试协议，用于压力测试战略经济互动中的智能体。结果表明，与静态基线相比，智能体更容易被利用。文中还展示了提炼出的提示规则在提高智能体鲁棒性方面的有效性。
summary_zh: 随着自主代理系统进入实际部署，它们的决策越来越依赖于外部输入，例如检索到的内容、工具的输出以及其他参与者提供的信息。当这些输入可以被对手策略性地塑造时，相关的安全风险就不仅仅局限于固定的提示攻击库，而是扩展到将代理引导到不利结果的自适应策略。我们提出了利润驱动的红队测试，这是一种压力测试协议，它用一个经过训练以最大化其利润的学习型对手来取代手工制作的攻击，而该学习型对手仅使用标量结果反馈。该协议不需要以LLM作为判断者的评分、攻击标签或攻击分类，并且专为具有可审计结果的结构化设置而设计。我们在一个包含四个典型经济互动的精简环境中实例化它，这为自适应可利用性提供了一个受控的试验平台。在受控实验中，在静态基线面前看似强大的代理在利润优化的压力下变得始终可被利用，并且学习型对手在没有明确指令的情况下发现了探测、锚定和欺骗性承诺。然后，我们将利用事件提炼成代理的简洁提示规则，这些规则使先前观察到的大多数失败变得无效，并大大提高了目标性能。这些结果表明，利润驱动的红队测试数据可以为提高具有可审计结果的结构化代理设置中的鲁棒性提供一种实用途径。

title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Action Recognition via Differentially Private Selective Tuning and Efficient Communication
summary: Federated video action recognition enables collaborative model training without sharing raw video data, yet remains vulnerable to two key challenges: \textit{model exposure} and \textit{communication overhead}. Gradients exchanged between clients and the server can leak private motion patterns, while full-model synchronization of high-dimensional video networks causes significant bandwidth and communication costs. To address these issues, we propose \textit{Federated Differential Privacy with Selective Tuning and Efficient Communication for Action Recognition}, namely \textit{FedDP-STECAR}. Our \textit{FedDP-STECAR} framework selectively fine-tunes and perturbs only a small subset of task-relevant layers under Differential Privacy (DP), reducing the surface of information leakage while preserving temporal coherence in video features. By transmitting only the tuned layers during aggregation, communication traffic is reduced by over 99\% compared to full-model updates. Experiments on the UCF-101 dataset using the MViT-B-16x4 transformer show that \textit{FedDP-STECAR} achieves up to \textbf{70.2\% higher accuracy} under strict privacy ($ε=0.65$) in centralized settings and \textbf{48\% faster training} with \textbf{73.1\% accuracy} in federated setups, enabling scalable and privacy-preserving video action recognition. Code available at https://github.com/izakariyya/mvit-federated-videodp
tldr: The paper introduces FedDP-STECAR, a federated learning framework for video action recognition that uses differential privacy and selective tuning to reduce information leakage and communication overhead, achieving significant accuracy and training speed improvements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FedDP-STECAR，一个用于视频行为识别的联邦学习框架，该框架使用差分隐私和选择性调整来减少信息泄露和通信开销，实现了显著的准确性和训练速度提升。
summary_zh: 联邦视频动作识别能够在不共享原始视频数据的情况下进行协同模型训练，但仍然容易受到两个关键挑战的影响：\textit{模型暴露} 和 \textit{通信开销}。客户端和服务器之间交换的梯度可能会泄露私有运动模式，而高维视频网络的完整模型同步会导致显著的带宽和通信成本。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了\textit{具有选择性调整和高效通信的联邦差分隐私动作识别} (Federated Differential Privacy with Selective Tuning and Efficient Communication for Action Recognition)，即 \textit{FedDP-STECAR}。我们的 \textit{FedDP-STECAR} 框架在差分隐私 (DP) 的约束下，有选择性地微调和扰动任务相关层的一小部分子集，从而在保留视频特征中的时间连贯性的同时，减少信息泄露面。通过仅传输聚合期间调整的层，与完整模型更新相比，通信流量减少了 99\% 以上。在使用 MViT-B-16x4 Transformer 的 UCF-101 数据集上的实验表明，在严格隐私 ($ε=0.65$) 的集中式设置下，\textit{FedDP-STECAR} 实现了高达 \textbf{70.2\% 的精度提升}，在联邦设置中实现了 \textbf{48\% 的训练速度提升} 和 \textbf{73.1\% 的精度}，从而实现了可扩展且保护隐私的视频动作识别。代码可在 https://github.com/izakariyya/mvit-federated-videodp 获取。

title: Incentivizing Generative Zero-Shot Learning via Outcome-Reward Reinforcement Learning with Visual Cues
summary: Recent advances in zero-shot learning (ZSL) have demonstrated the potential of generative models. Typically, generative ZSL synthesizes visual features conditioned on semantic prototypes to model the data distribution of unseen classes, followed by training a classifier on the synthesized data. However, the synthesized features often remain task-agnostic, leading to degraded performance. Moreover, inferring a faithful distribution from semantic prototypes alone is insufficient for classes that are semantically similar but visually distinct. To address these and advance ZSL, we propose RLVC, an outcome-reward reinforcement learning RL framework with visual cues for generative ZSL. At its core, RL empowers the generative model to self-evolve, implicitly enhancing its generation capability. In particular, RLVC updates the generative model using an outcome-based reward, encouraging the synthesis of task-relevant features. Furthermore, we introduce class-wise visual cues that (i) align synthesized features with visual prototypes and (ii) stabilize the RL training updates. For the training process, we present a novel cold-start strategy. Comprehensive experiments and analyses on three prevalent ZSL benchmarks demonstrate that RLVC achieves state-of-the-art results with a 4.7% gain.
tldr: This paper introduces RLVC, a reinforcement learning framework with visual cues to improve generative zero-shot learning by creating task-relevant and visually aligned synthesized features, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RLVC，一个利用视觉线索的强化学习框架，通过生成任务相关的且视觉对齐的合成特征来改进生成式零样本学习，并取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 零样本学习(ZSL)的最新进展展示了生成模型的潜力。通常，生成式ZSL通过生成以语义原型为条件的视觉特征来建模未见类的数据分布，然后基于合成的数据训练分类器。然而，合成的特征通常仍然是任务无关的，导致性能下降。此外，仅从语义原型推断出真实分布对于语义相似但视觉上不同的类别来说是不够的。为了解决这些问题并推进ZSL，我们提出了一种RLVC框架，即一种基于结果奖励的强化学习(RL)框架，该框架利用视觉线索进行生成式ZSL。RL的核心在于赋予生成模型自我进化的能力，从而隐式地增强其生成能力。特别地，RLVC使用基于结果的回报来更新生成模型，鼓励合成与任务相关的特征。此外，我们引入了类别的视觉线索，这些线索(i)使合成的特征与视觉原型对齐，以及(ii)稳定RL训练更新。对于训练过程，我们提出了一种新颖的冷启动策略。在三个流行的ZSL基准数据集上的综合实验和分析表明，RLVC实现了最先进的结果，且性能提升了4.7%。

title: LiFR-Seg: Anytime High-Frame-Rate Segmentation via Event-Guided Propagation
summary: Dense semantic segmentation in dynamic environments is fundamentally limited by the low-frame-rate (LFR) nature of standard cameras, which creates critical perceptual gaps between frames. To solve this, we introduce Anytime Interframe Semantic Segmentation: a new task for predicting segmentation at any arbitrary time using only a single past RGB frame and a stream of asynchronous event data. This task presents a core challenge: how to robustly propagate dense semantic features using a motion field derived from sparse and often noisy event data, all while mitigating feature degradation in highly dynamic scenes. We propose LiFR-Seg, a novel framework that directly addresses these challenges by propagating deep semantic features through time. The core of our method is an uncertainty-aware warping process, guided by an event-driven motion field and its learned, explicit confidence. A temporal memory attention module further ensures coherence in dynamic scenarios. We validate our method on the DSEC dataset and a new high-frequency synthetic benchmark (SHF-DSEC) we contribute. Remarkably, our LFR system achieves performance (73.82% mIoU on DSEC) that is statistically indistinguishable from an HFR upper-bound (within 0.09%) that has full access to the target frame. This work presents a new, efficient paradigm for achieving robust, high-frame-rate perception with low-frame-rate hardware. Project Page: https://candy-crusher.github.io/LiFR_Seg_Proj/#; Code: https://github.com/Candy-Crusher/LiFR-Seg.git.
tldr: LiFR-Seg introduces a method for high-frame-rate semantic segmentation from low-frame-rate video by using asynchronous event data to guide feature propagation, achieving performance comparable to high-frame-rate methods.
tldr_zh: LiFR-Seg 提出了一种利用异步事件数据引导特征传播，从低帧率视频中实现高帧率语义分割的方法，其性能与高帧率方法相当。
summary_zh: 动态环境下的密集语义分割从根本上受到标准相机低帧率（LFR）的限制，这会在帧之间产生关键的感知间隙。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了随时帧间语义分割：一项新的任务，旨在使用单一过去的RGB帧和异步事件数据的流来预测任意时间的分割。这项任务带来了一个核心挑战：如何使用从稀疏且通常嘈杂的事件数据中导出的运动场来稳健地传播密集语义特征，同时减轻高度动态场景中的特征退化。我们提出了LiFR-Seg，一个新颖的框架，通过时间传播深度语义特征来直接应对这些挑战。我们方法的核心是一个不确定性感知的扭曲过程，由事件驱动的运动场及其学习到的显式置信度来引导。一个时间记忆注意力模块进一步确保了动态场景中的连贯性。我们在DSEC数据集和我们贡献的一个新的高频合成基准（SHF-DSEC）上验证了我们的方法。值得注意的是，我们的LFR系统达到了与HFR上限在统计上无法区分的性能（在DSEC上为73.82% mIoU，差距在0.09%以内），而HFR上限可以完全访问目标帧。这项工作提出了一种新的、高效的范例，用于使用低帧率硬件实现稳健的、高帧率的感知。项目主页：https://candy-crusher.github.io/LiFR_Seg_Proj/#; 代码：https://github.com/Candy-Crusher/LiFR-Seg.git。

title: Single-Eye View: Monocular Real-time Perception Package for Autonomous Driving
summary: Amidst the rapid advancement of camera-based autonomous driving technology, effectiveness is often prioritized with limited attention to computational efficiency. To address this issue, this paper introduces LRHPerception, a real-time monocular perception package for autonomous driving that uses single-view camera video to interpret the surrounding environment. The proposed system combines the computational efficiency of end-to-end learning with the rich representational detail of local mapping methodologies. With significant improvements in object tracking and prediction, road segmentation, and depth estimation integrated into a unified framework, LRHPerception processes monocular image data into a five-channel tensor consisting of RGB, road segmentation, and pixel-level depth estimation, augmented with object detection and trajectory prediction. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance, achieving real-time processing at 29 FPS on a single GPU, representing a 555% speedup over the fastest mapping-based approach.
tldr: The paper introduces LRHPerception, a real-time monocular perception package for autonomous driving with significant improvements in object tracking, road segmentation, depth estimation, and computational efficiency, achieving 29 FPS on a single GPU.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LRHPerception，这是一个用于自动驾驶的实时单目感知软件包，在目标跟踪、道路分割、深度估计和计算效率方面都有显著的改进，在单个GPU上实现了29 FPS的处理速度。
summary_zh: 在基于摄像头的自动驾驶技术快速发展的背景下，有效性往往被优先考虑，而对计算效率的关注有限。为了解决这个问题，本文介绍了一种名为LRHPerception的实时单目感知软件包，用于自动驾驶，它利用单视角摄像头的视频来解读周围环境。该系统结合了端到端学习的计算效率和局部地图构建方法丰富的表征细节。 LRHPerception将对象跟踪和预测、道路分割以及深度估计方面的显著改进集成到一个统一的框架中，将单目图像数据处理成一个五通道张量，该张量由RGB、道路分割和像素级深度估计组成，并辅以对象检测和轨迹预测。实验结果表明了其强大的性能，在单GPU上实现了29 FPS的实时处理速度，相比最快的基于地图构建的方法，速度提升了555%。

title: Active Inference Agency Formalization, Metrics, and Convergence Assessments
summary:
This paper addresses the critical challenge of mesa-optimization in AI safety by providing a formal definition of agency and a framework for its analysis. Agency is conceptualized as a Continuous Representation of accumulated experience that achieves autopoiesis through a dynamic balance between curiosity (minimizing prediction error to ensure non-computability and novelty) and empowerment (maximizing the control channel's information capacity to ensure subjectivity and goal-directedness). Empirical evidence suggests that this active inference-based model successfully accounts for classical instrumental goals, such as self-preservation and resource acquisition.
  The analysis demonstrates that the proposed agency function is smooth and convex, possessing favorable properties for optimization. While agentic functions occupy a vanishingly small fraction of the total abstract function space, they exhibit logarithmic convergence in sparse environments. This suggests a high probability for the spontaneous emergence of agency during the training of modern, large-scale models.
  To quantify the degree of agency, the paper introduces a metric based on the distance between the behavioral equivalents of a given system and an "ideal" agentic function within the space of canonicalized rewards (STARC). This formalization provides a concrete apparatus for classifying and detecting mesa-optimizers by measuring their proximity to an ideal agentic objective, offering a robust tool for analyzing and identifying undesirable inner optimization in complex AI systems.
tldr: This paper formalizes agency in AI, proposes a method for detecting mesa-optimizers based on active inference, and claims logarithmic convergence of agency in sparse environments, suggesting it could spontaneously emerge in large-scale models.
tldr_zh: 本文形式化了人工智能中的代理性，提出了一种基于主动推理检测中间优化器的方法，并声称代理性在稀疏环境中呈对数收敛，表明它可能自发地出现在大型模型中。
summary_zh:
本文针对人工智能安全领域中中介目标优化这一关键挑战，提出了一种代理性的正式定义以及用于分析代理性的框架。代理性被概念化为累积经验的连续表示，通过好奇心（最小化预测误差以确保不可计算性和新颖性）与赋权（最大化控制通道的信息容量以确保主观性和目标导向性）之间的动态平衡来实现自创生。经验证据表明，这种基于主动推理的模型成功地解释了经典的工具性目标，如自我保护和资源获取。

分析表明，所提出的代理性函数是平滑且凸的，具有有利于优化的性质。虽然代理函数在整个抽象函数空间中占据的比例非常小，但它们在稀疏环境中表现出对数收敛性。这表明在现代大规模模型的训练过程中，自发产生代理性的概率很高。

为了量化代理性的程度，本文引入了一种基于给定系统的行为等价物与规范化奖励空间（STARC）内“理想”代理函数之间距离的度量标准。这种形式化为通过测量其与理想代理目标的接近程度来分类和检测中介目标优化器提供了一种具体的手段，为分析和识别复杂人工智能系统中不良的内部优化提供了一种稳健的工具。

title: Active Inference for Physical AI Agents -- An Engineering Perspective
summary: Physical AI agents, such as robots and other embodied systems operating under tight and fluctuating resource constraints, remain far less capable than biological agents in open-ended real-world environments. This paper argues that Active Inference (AIF), grounded in the Free Energy Principle, offers a principled foundation for closing that gap. We develop this argument from first principles, following a chain from probability theory through Bayesian machine learning and variational inference to active inference and reactive message passing. From the FEP perspective, systems that maintain their structural and functional integrity over time can, under suitable assumptions, be described as minimizing variational free energy (VFE), and AIF operationalizes this by unifying perception, learning, planning, and control within a single computational objective. We show that VFE minimization is naturally realized by reactive message passing on factor graphs, where inference emerges from local, parallel computations. This realization is well matched to the constraints of physical operation, including hard deadlines, asynchronous data, fluctuating power budgets, and changing environments. Because reactive message passing is event-driven, interruptible, and locally adaptable, performance degrades gracefully under reduced resources while model structure can adjust online. We further show that, under suitable coupling and coarse-graining conditions, coupled AIF agents can be described as higher-level AIF agents, yielding a homogeneous architecture based on the same message-passing primitive across scales. Our contribution is not empirical benchmarking, but a clear theoretical and architectural case for the engineering community.
tldr: This paper presents a theoretical argument for using Active Inference (AIF) as a unifying framework for physical AI agents, emphasizing its suitability for resource-constrained and real-world environments through reactive message passing implementation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个理论论点，认为主动推理(AIF)可以作为物理AI代理的统一框架，并强调其通过反应式消息传递实现，适用于资源受限的现实环境。
summary_zh: 在资源紧张且波动剧烈的真实开放环境中，物理人工智能体，例如机器人和其他具身系统，其能力远不及生物智能体。本文认为，基于自由能原理的主动推断(AIF)为弥合这一差距提供了原则性的基础。我们从第一性原理出发，按照从概率论到贝叶斯机器学习，再到变分推断、主动推断和反应式消息传递的链条，来论证这一观点。从自由能原理的角度来看，在适当的假设下，能够长期保持其结构和功能完整性的系统可以被描述为最小化变分自由能(VFE)，而AIF通过在一个单一的计算目标下统一感知、学习、规划和控制来实现这一点。我们证明了变分自由能的最小化自然可以通过因子图上的反应式消息传递来实现，其中推断产生于局部的、并行的计算。这种实现方式非常适合物理操作的约束，包括严格的截止期限、异步数据、波动的功率预算和变化的环境。由于反应式消息传递是事件驱动的、可中断的、且可以局部适应，因此在资源减少的情况下性能能够平稳下降，同时模型结构可以在线调整。我们进一步表明，在适当的耦合和粗粒化条件下，耦合的AIF智能体可以被描述为高级AIF智能体，从而产生一个基于相同消息传递原语的跨尺度同质架构。我们的贡献不是经验基准测试，而是为工程界提供了一个清晰的理论和架构案例。

title: Evaluating Factor-Wise Auxiliary Dynamics Supervision for Latent Structure and Robustness in Simulated Humanoid Locomotion
summary: We evaluate whether factor-wise auxiliary dynamics supervision produces useful latent structure or improved robustness in simulated humanoid locomotion. DynaMITE -- a transformer encoder with a factored 24-d latent trained by per-factor auxiliary losses during proximal policy optimization (PPO) -- is compared against Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), plain Transformer, and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) baselines on a Unitree G1 humanoid across four Isaac Lab tasks. The supervised latent shows no evidence of decodable or functionally separable factor structure: probe R^2 ~ 0 for all five dynamics factors, clamping any subspace changes reward by < 0.05, and standard disentanglement metrics (MIG, DCI, SAP) are near zero. An unsupervised LSTM hidden state achieves higher probe R^2 (up to 0.10). A 2x2 factorial ablation (n = 10 seeds) isolates the contributions of the tanh bottleneck and auxiliary losses: the auxiliary losses show no measurable effect on either in-distribution (ID) reward (+0.03, p = 0.732) or severe out-of-distribution (OOD) reward (+0.03, p = 0.669), while the bottleneck shows a small, consistent advantage in both regimes (ID: +0.16, p = 0.207; OOD: +0.10, p = 0.208). The bottleneck advantage persists under severe combined perturbation but does not amplify, indicating a training-time representation benefit rather than a robustness mechanism. LSTM achieves the best nominal reward on all four tasks (p < 0.03); DynaMITE degrades less under combined-shift stress (2.3% vs. 16.7%), but this difference is attributable to the bottleneck compression, not the auxiliary supervision. For locomotion practitioners: auxiliary dynamics supervision does not produce an interpretable estimator and does not measurably improve reward or robustness beyond what the bottleneck alone provides; recurrent baselines remain the stronger choice for nominal performance.
