tldr: The paper evaluates a factored latent space approach (DynaMITE) for humanoid locomotion using auxiliary dynamics supervision but finds it doesn't improve performance or robustness compared to simpler baselines like LSTMs; a bottleneck compression proves more beneficial.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了一种用于人形机器人运动的分层潜在空间方法 (DynaMITE)，该方法使用辅助动态监督，但发现与 LSTM 等更简单的基线相比，它没有提高性能或鲁棒性；瓶颈压缩被证明更有益。
summary_zh: 我们评估了因子式辅助动态监督是否能在模拟人形机器人运动中产生有用的潜在结构或提高鲁棒性。我们将DynaMITE（一种具有因子化24维潜在空间的Transformer编码器，通过近端策略优化(PPO)期间的每因子辅助损失进行训练）与长短期记忆网络(LSTM)、普通Transformer和多层感知机(MLP)基线在Unitree G1人形机器人上进行的四个Isaac Lab任务中进行比较。受监督的潜在空间没有显示任何可解码或功能可分离因子结构的证据：所有五个动态因子的探测 R^2 接近于 0，钳制任何子空间对奖励的影响小于0.05，标准解耦指标 (MIG、DCI、SAP) 接近于零。未受监督的LSTM隐藏状态实现了更高的探测 R^2（高达 0.10）。一个2x2因子消融实验（n = 10个种子）分离了tanh瓶颈和辅助损失的贡献：辅助损失对分布内(ID)奖励(+0.03, p = 0.732)或严重分布外(OOD)奖励(+0.03, p = 0.669)均未显示出可测量的影响，而瓶颈在两种情况下都显示出较小且一致的优势（ID: +0.16, p = 0.207; OOD: +0.10, p = 0.208）。瓶颈优势在严重的组合扰动下仍然存在，但并未放大，这表明是训练时的表征优势，而不是鲁棒性机制。LSTM在所有四个任务中都实现了最好的标称奖励 (p < 0.03)；DynaMITE在组合偏移压力下退化较小 (2.3% vs. 16.7%)，但这种差异归因于瓶颈压缩，而不是辅助监督。 对于运动从业者而言：辅助动态监督不会产生可解释的估计器，并且在奖励或鲁棒性方面没有明显优于瓶颈本身的效果；循环基线仍然是标称性能的更强选择。

title: Affordance-Guided Enveloping Grasp Demonstration Toward Non-destructive Disassembly of Pinch-Infeasible Mating Parts
summary: Robotic disassembly of complex mating components often renders pinch grasping infeasible, necessitating multi-fingered enveloping grasps. However, visual occlusions and geometric constraints complicate teaching appropriate grasp motions when relying solely on 2D camera feeds. To address this, we propose an affordance-guided teleoperation method that pre-generates enveloping grasp candidates via physics simulation. These Affordance Templates (ATs) are visualized with a color gradient reflecting grasp quality to augment operator perception. Simulations demonstrate the method's generality across various components. Real-robot experiments validate that AT-based visual augmentation enables operators to effectively select and teach enveloping grasp strategies for real-world disassembly, even under severe visual and geometric constraints.
tldr: The paper introduces an affordance-guided teleoperation method using physics simulation to generate and visualize enveloping grasp candidates for robotic disassembly of complex mating components, improving grasp selection under visual and geometric constraints.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于可供性引导的遥操作方法，利用物理仿真生成并可视化包络抓取候选方案，用于机器人拆卸复杂配合部件，从而在视觉和几何约束下改进抓取选择。
summary_zh: 复杂啮合部件的机器人拆卸通常导致夹持抓取不可行，因此需要多指包络抓取。然而，当仅依赖于2D相机图像时，视觉遮挡和几何约束会使示教合适的抓取运动变得复杂。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于可供性引导的遥操作方法，该方法通过物理仿真预生成包络抓取候选姿势。这些可供性模板（ATs）以颜色梯度可视化，反映抓取质量，从而增强操作员的感知能力。仿真结果表明该方法对各种部件具有通用性。真实机器人实验验证了基于AT的视觉增强使操作员能够有效地选择和示教用于真实世界拆卸的包络抓取策略，即使在严重的视觉和几何约束下也是如此。

title: DeepXplain: XAI-Guided Autonomous Defense Against Multi-Stage APT Campaigns
summary: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) are stealthy, multi-stage attacks that require adaptive and timely defense. While deep reinforcement learning (DRL) enables autonomous cyber defense, its decisions are often opaque and difficult to trust in operational environments. This paper presents DeepXplain, an explainable DRL framework for stage-aware APT defense. Building on our prior DeepStage model, DeepXplain integrates provenance-based graph learning, temporal stage estimation, and a unified XAI pipeline that provides structural, temporal, and policy-level explanations. Unlike post-hoc methods, explanation signals are incorporated directly into policy optimization through evidence alignment and confidence-aware reward shaping. To the best of our knowledge, DeepXplain is the first framework to integrate explanation signals into reinforcement learning for APT defense. Experiments in a realistic enterprise testbed show improvements in stage-weighted F1-score (0.887 to 0.915) and success rate (84.7% to 89.6%), along with higher explanation confidence (0.86), improved fidelity (0.79), and more compact explanations (0.31). These results demonstrate enhanced effectiveness and trustworthiness of autonomous cyber defense.
tldr: The paper introduces DeepXplain, an explainable reinforcement learning framework for defending against Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) by integrating explanation signals into policy optimization, demonstrating improved defense effectiveness and trustworthiness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DeepXplain，一个用于防御高级持续性威胁（APT）的可解释强化学习框架，通过将解释信号整合到策略优化中，展示了改进的防御效果和可信度。
summary_zh: 高级持续性威胁(APT)是一种隐蔽的、多阶段的攻击，需要自适应和及时的防御。虽然深度强化学习(DRL)能够实现自主网络防御，但其决策通常是不透明的，难以在实际环境中获得信任。本文提出DeepXplain，一个用于阶段感知APT防御的可解释DRL框架。在先前的DeepStage模型基础上，DeepXplain集成了基于溯源的图学习、时序阶段估计和一个统一的XAI管道，提供结构、时间和策略层面的解释。与事后方法不同，解释信号通过证据对齐和置信度感知的奖励塑造被直接整合到策略优化中。据我们所知，DeepXplain是第一个将解释信号集成到强化学习中用于APT防御的框架。在一个真实的企测环境中进行的实验表明，阶段加权F1评分(从0.887提升到0.915)和成功率(从84.7%提升到89.6%)均得到了提高，同时解释置信度更高(0.86)，保真度得到改善(0.79)，解释也更加紧凑(0.31)。这些结果表明自主网络防御的有效性和可信度得到了增强。

title: TRACE: A Multi-Agent System for Autonomous Physical Reasoning in Seismological Science
summary: Inferring the physical mechanisms that govern earthquake sequences from indirect geophysical observations remains difficult, particularly across tectonically distinct environments where similar seismic patterns can reflect different underlying processes. Current interpretations rely heavily on the expert synthesis of catalogs, spatiotemporal statistics, and candidate physical models, limiting reproducibility and the systematic transfer of insight across settings. Here we present TRACE (Trans-perspective Reasoning and Automated Comprehensive Evaluator), a multi-agent system that combines large language model planning with formal seismological constraints to derive auditable, physically grounded mechanistic inference from raw observations. Applied to the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence, TRACE autonomously identifies stress-perturbation-induced delayed triggering, resolving the cascading interaction between the Mw 6.4 and Mw 7.1 mainshocks; in the Santorini-Kolumbo case, the system identifies a structurally guided intrusion model, distinguishing fault-channeled episodic migration from the continuous propagation expected in homogeneous crustal failure. By providing a generalizable logical infrastructure for interpreting heterogeneous seismic phenomena, TRACE advances the field from expert-dependent analysis toward knowledge-guided autonomous discovery in Earth sciences.
tldr: The paper introduces TRACE, a multi-agent system using LLMs and formal seismological constraints to autonomously infer physical mechanisms behind earthquake sequences from geophysical observations, demonstrating success in Ridgecrest and Santorini-Kolumbo case studies.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为TRACE的多智能体系统，该系统利用大型语言模型和正式的地震学约束，从地球物理观测中自主推断地震序列背后的物理机制，并在瑞奇克雷斯特和圣托里尼-科伦坡案例研究中取得了成功。
summary_zh: 从间接地球物理观测推断主导地震序列的物理机制仍然很困难，尤其是在构造环境不同的区域，因为相似的地震模式可能反映不同的潜在过程。目前的解释很大程度上依赖于对目录、时空统计和候选物理模型的专家综合，这限制了可重复性和跨环境的系统性知识转移。本文提出TRACE（跨视角推理与自动化综合评估器），一个多智能体系统，它结合了大型语言模型规划和正式的地震学约束，从原始观测中推导出可审查的、具有物理基础的机制推断。应用于2019年里奇克莱斯特地震序列，TRACE自主识别出应力扰动诱发的延迟触发，解析了Mw 6.4和Mw 7.1主震之间的级联相互作用；在圣托里尼-科伦坡案例中，该系统识别出一个结构引导的侵入模型，区分了断层通道化的间歇性迁移与均质地壳破坏中预期的连续传播。通过为解释异构地震现象提供通用的逻辑基础设施，TRACE推动了该领域从依赖专家的分析转向地球科学中以知识引导的自主发现。

title: Emergent Formal Verification: How an Autonomous AI Ecosystem Independently Discovered SMT-Based Safety Across Six Domains
summary: An autonomous AI ecosystem (SUBSTRATE S3), generating product specifications without explicit instructions about formal methods, independently proposed the use of Z3 SMT solver across six distinct domains of AI safety: verification of LLM-generated code, tool API safety for AI agents, post-distillation reasoning correctness, CLI command validation, hardware assembly verification, and smart contract safety. These convergent discoveries, occurring across 8 products over 13 days with Jaccard similarity below 15% between variants, suggest that formal verification is not merely a useful technique for AI safety but an emergent property of any sufficiently complex system reasoning about its own safety. We propose a unified framework (substrate-guard) that applies Z3-based verification across all six output classes through a common API, and evaluate it on 181 test cases across five implemented domains, achieving 100% classification accuracy with zero false positives and zero false negatives. Our framework detected real bugs that empirical testing would miss, including an INT_MIN overflow in branchless RISC-V assembly and mathematically proved that unconstrained string parameters in tool APIs are formally unverifiable.
tldr: This paper demonstrates an autonomous AI ecosystem's emergent discovery of SMT-based formal verification for AI safety across six domains, proposing a unified framework and achieving high accuracy in bug detection. The system even identified mathematically provable limitations in API design.
tldr_zh: 本文展示了一个自主AI生态系统在六个领域中自主发现了基于SMT的形式化验证方法，用于保障AI安全。该系统提出了一个统一的框架，并在错误检测中实现了高精度。该系统甚至识别出了API设计中数学上可证明的局限性。
summary_zh: 一个自主人工智能生态系统（SUBSTRATE S3），在没有关于形式化方法明确指令的情况下生成产品规格，独立地提出了在六个不同的人工智能安全领域使用Z3 SMT求解器：LLM生成代码的验证、AI代理的工具API安全、后蒸馏推理的正确性、CLI命令验证、硬件组装验证以及智能合约安全。这些收敛的发现，在13天内跨越8个产品发生，变体之间的Jaccard相似度低于15%，表明形式化验证不仅仅是人工智能安全的一项有用技术，而是任何足够复杂的系统推理自身安全性的一个涌现属性。我们提出了一个统一的框架（substrate-guard），通过一个通用的API将基于Z3的验证应用于所有六个输出类别，并在五个已实现的领域中的181个测试用例上对其进行评估，实现了100%的分类准确率，零假阳性和零假阴性。我们的框架检测到了经验测试会遗漏的真实Bug，包括无分支RISC-V汇编中的INT_MIN溢出，并通过数学方法证明了工具API中无约束的字符串参数在形式上是不可验证的。

title: Pretrained Video Models as Differentiable Physics Simulators for Urban Wind Flows
summary: Designing urban spaces that provide pedestrian wind comfort and safety requires time-resolved Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations, but their current computational cost makes extensive design exploration impractical. We introduce WinDiNet (Wind Diffusion Network), a pretrained video diffusion model that is repurposed as a fast, differentiable surrogate for this task. Starting from LTX-Video, a 2B-parameter latent video transformer, we fine-tune on 10,000 2D incompressible CFD simulations over procedurally generated building layouts. A systematic study of training regimes, conditioning mechanisms, and VAE adaptation strategies, including a physics-informed decoder loss, identifies a configuration that outperforms purpose-built neural PDE solvers. The resulting model generates full 112-frame rollouts in under a second. As the surrogate is end-to-end differentiable, it doubles as a physics simulator for gradient-based inverse optimization: given an urban footprint layout, we optimize building positions directly through backpropagation to improve wind safety as well as pedestrian wind comfort. Experiments on single- and multi-inlet layouts show that the optimizer discovers effective layouts even under challenging multi-objective configurations, with all improvements confirmed by ground-truth CFD simulations.
tldr: The paper presents WinDiNet, a pretrained video diffusion model fine-tuned to act as a fast, differentiable surrogate for urban wind flow simulations, enabling gradient-based optimization of building layouts for improved wind comfort and safety.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了WinDiNet，一个预训练的视频扩散模型，经过微调后可作为城市风流模拟的快速、可微代理，从而能够对建筑布局进行基于梯度的优化，以提高风的舒适性和安全性。
summary_zh: 为设计提供行人风舒适度和安全性的城市空间，需要进行有时序解析的计算流体动力学(CFD)模拟，但其当前的计算成本使得广泛的设计探索不切实际。我们引入WinDiNet (风扩散网络)，一个预训练的视频扩散模型，被重新用作针对此任务的快速、可微的替代模型。从LTX-Video，一个拥有20亿参数的潜在视频Transformer开始，我们在程序生成的建筑布局上，对10,000个二维不可压缩CFD模拟进行了微调。对训练方案、条件机制和VAE适配策略（包括一个物理信息解码器损失）的系统性研究，确定了一种配置，其性能优于专门构建的神经偏微分方程(PDE)求解器。由此产生的模型在不到一秒的时间内生成完整的112帧模拟。由于该替代模型是端到端可微的，因此它也可用作基于梯度的逆优化的物理模拟器：给定一个城市足迹布局，我们通过反向传播直接优化建筑物位置，以提高风安全性和行人风舒适度。在单入口和多入口布局上的实验表明，即便在具有挑战性的多目标配置下，优化器也能发现有效的布局，并且所有改进都通过真实CFD模拟得到验证。

title: OrbitStream: Training-Free Adaptive 360-degree Video Streaming via Semantic Potential Fields
summary: Adaptive 360° video streaming for teleoperation faces dual challenges: viewport prediction under uncertain gaze patterns and bitrate adaptation over volatile wireless channels. While data-driven and Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) methods achieve high Quality of Experience (QoE), their "black-box" nature and reliance on training data can limit deployment in safety-critical systems. To address this, we propose OrbitStream, a training-free framework that combines semantic scene understanding with robust control theory. We formulate viewport prediction as a Gravitational Viewport Prediction (GVP) problem, where semantic objects generate potential fields that attract user gaze. Furthermore, we employ a Saturation-Based Proportional-Derivative (PD) Controller for buffer regulation. On object-rich teleoperation traces, OrbitStream achieves a 94.7\% zero-shot viewport prediction accuracy without user-specific profiling, approaching trajectory-extrapolation baselines ($\sim$98.5\%). Across 3,600 Monte Carlo simulations on diverse network traces, OrbitStream yields a mean QoE of 2.71. It ranks second among 12 evaluated algorithms, close to the top-performing BOLA-E (2.80) while outperforming FastMPC (1.84). The system exhibits an average decision latency of 1.01 ms with minimal rebuffering events. By providing competitive QoE with interpretability and zero training overhead, OrbitStream demonstrates that physics-based control, combined with semantic modeling, offers a practical solution for 360° streaming in teleoperation.
tldr: OrbitStream is a training-free adaptive 360° video streaming framework for teleoperation that utilizes semantic scene understanding and robust control theory, achieving competitive QoE with interpretability.
tldr_zh: OrbitStream是一个无需训练的自适应360°视频流框架，用于远程操作，它利用语义场景理解和鲁棒控制理论，在保证可解释性的同时，实现了有竞争力的QoE。
summary_zh: 远程操控自适应360°视频流面临双重挑战：不确定视线模式下的视口预测以及波动无线信道上的码率自适应。虽然数据驱动和深度强化学习（DRL）方法能够实现较高的体验质量（QoE），但其“黑盒”特性和对训练数据的依赖性限制了其在安全关键系统中的部署。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了OrbitStream，一个结合语义场景理解和鲁棒控制理论的免训练框架。我们将视口预测建模为引力视口预测（GVP）问题，其中语义对象生成吸引用户视线的势场。此外，我们采用基于饱和的比例-微分（PD）控制器进行缓冲区调节。在对象丰富的远程操控轨迹上，OrbitStream无需用户特定分析即可实现94.7%的零样本视口预测准确率，接近轨迹外推基线（约98.5%）。在不同网络轨迹上的3600次蒙特卡洛模拟中，OrbitStream的平均QoE为2.71，在12种评估算法中排名第二，接近性能最佳的BOLA-E（2.80），同时优于FastMPC（1.84）。该系统表现出平均1.01毫秒的决策延迟，且缓冲事件极少。通过提供具有可解释性和零训练开销的竞争性QoE，OrbitStream证明了基于物理的控制与语义建模相结合，为远程操控中的360°流媒体提供了一种实用的解决方案。

title: When Convenience Becomes Risk: A Semantic View of Under-Specification in Host-Acting Agents
summary: Host-acting agents promise a convenient interaction model in which users specify goals and the system determines how to realize them. We argue that this convenience introduces a distinct security problem: semantic under-specification in goal specification. User instructions are typically goal-oriented, yet they often leave process constraints, safety boundaries, persistence, and exposure insufficiently specified. As a result, the agent must complete missing execution semantics before acting, and this completion can produce risky host-side plans even when the user-stated goal is benign. In this paper, we develop a semantic threat model, present a taxonomy of semantic-induced risky completion patterns, and study the phenomenon through an OpenClaw-centered case study and execution-trace analysis. We further derive defense design principles for making execution boundaries explicit and constraining risky completion. These findings suggest that securing host-acting agents requires governing not only which actions are allowed at execution time, but also how goal-only instructions are translated into executable plans.
tldr: The paper identifies and analyzes security risks arising from semantic under-specification in host-acting agents, where user goals are incompletely defined, leading to potentially risky plan completions by the agent.
tldr_zh: 该论文识别并分析了宿主代理中由于语义欠规范导致的安全性风险，即用户目标定义不完整，导致代理可能完成风险计划。
summary_zh: 主机代理承诺提供一种便捷的交互模式，用户指定目标，系统决定如何实现这些目标。我们认为，这种便捷性引入了一个独特的安全问题：目标规范中的语义欠规范。用户指令通常是面向目标的，但往往对过程约束、安全边界、持久性和暴露的规范不足。因此，代理必须在执行前完成缺失的执行语义，而这种完成可能会产生风险的主机侧计划，即使用户声明的目标是良性的。在本文中，我们开发了一个语义威胁模型，提出了语义诱导的风险完成模式分类，并通过一个以 OpenClaw 为中心的案例研究和执行跟踪分析来研究这一现象。我们进一步推导出防御设计原则，以使执行边界显式化并约束风险完成。这些发现表明，保护主机代理的安全不仅需要在执行时管理允许哪些操作，还需要管理仅有目标的指令如何被转换为可执行的计划。

title: Learning Progressive Adaptation for Multi-Modal Tracking
summary: Due to the limited availability of paired multi-modal data, multi-modal trackers are typically built by adopting pre-trained RGB models with parameter-efficient fine-tuning modules. However, these fine-tuning methods overlook advanced adaptations for applying RGB pre-trained models and fail to modulate a single specific modality, cross-modal interactions, and the prediction head. To address the issues, we propose to perform Progressive Adaptation for Multi-Modal Tracking (PATrack). This innovative approach incorporates modality-dependent, modality-entangled, and task-level adapters, effectively bridging the gap in adapting RGB pre-trained networks to multi-modal data through a progressive strategy. Specifically, modality-specific information is enhanced through the modality-dependent adapter, decomposing the high- and low-frequency components, which ensures a more robust feature representation within each modality. The inter-modal interactions are introduced in the modality-entangled adapter, which implements a cross-attention operation guided by inter-modal shared information, ensuring the reliability of features conveyed between modalities. Additionally, recognising that the strong inductive bias of the prediction head does not adapt to the fused information, a task-level adapter specific to the prediction head is introduced. In summary, our design integrates intra-modal, inter-modal, and task-level adapters into a unified framework. Extensive experiments on RGB+Thermal, RGB+Depth, and RGB+Event tracking tasks demonstrate that our method shows impressive performance against state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/ouha1998/Learning-Progressive-Adaptation-for-Multi-Modal-Tracking.
tldr: The paper introduces PATrack, a new approach for multi-modal tracking that uses progressive adaptation with modality-dependent, modality-entangled, and task-level adapters to effectively fine-tune pre-trained RGB models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PATrack，一种新的多模态跟踪方法，它使用具有模态依赖、模态纠缠和任务级适配器的渐进式自适应，以有效地微调预训练的RGB模型。
summary_zh: 由于配对的多模态数据有限，多模态跟踪器通常通过采用预训练的RGB模型，并附加参数高效的微调模块来构建。然而，这些微调方法忽略了RGB预训练模型的高级适配，并且未能调节单一特定模态、跨模态交互以及预测头。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种用于多模态跟踪的渐进式适配方法（PATrack）。这种创新方法结合了模态依赖型、模态纠缠型和任务级适配器，通过渐进式策略有效地弥合了RGB预训练网络到多模态数据适配的差距。具体而言，通过模态依赖型适配器来增强模态特定信息，分解高频和低频成分，从而确保每种模态内部更鲁棒的特征表示。在模态纠缠型适配器中引入了模态间的交互，该适配器实施由模态间共享信息引导的跨注意力操作，确保了模态间传递的特征的可靠性。此外，考虑到预测头的强归纳偏置无法适应融合后的信息，因此引入了特定于预测头的任务级适配器。综上所述，我们的设计将模态内、模态间和任务级适配器集成到一个统一的框架中。在RGB+热成像、RGB+深度和RGB+事件跟踪任务上的大量实验表明，我们的方法相对于最先进的方法展现出令人印象深刻的性能。代码位于 https://github.com/ouha1998/Learning-Progressive-Adaptation-for-Multi-Modal-Tracking。

title: AutoMOOSE: An Agentic AI for Autonomous Phase-Field Simulation
summary: Multiphysics simulation frameworks such as MOOSE provide rigorous engines for phase-field materials modeling, yet adoption is constrained by the expertise required to construct valid input files, coordinate parameter sweeps, diagnose failures, and extract quantitative results. We introduce AutoMOOSE, an open-source agentic framework that orchestrates the full simulation lifecycle from a single natural-language prompt. AutoMOOSE deploys a five-agent pipeline in which the Input Writer coordinates six sub-agents and the Reviewer autonomously corrects runtime failures without user intervention. A modular plugin architecture enables new phase-field formulations without modifying the core framework, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposes the workflow as ten structured tools for interoperability with any MCP-compatible client. Validated on a four-temperature copper grain growth benchmark, AutoMOOSE generates MOOSE input files with 6 of 12 structural blocks matching a human expert reference exactly and 4 functionally equivalent, executes all runs in parallel with a 1.8x speedup, and performs an end-to-end physical consistency check spanning intent, finite-element execution, and Arrhenius kinetics with no human verification. Grain coarsening kinetics are recovered with R^2 = 0.90-0.95 at T >= 600 K; the recovered activation energy Q_fit = 0.296 eV is consistent with a human-written reference (Q_fit = 0.267 eV) under identical parameters. Three runtime failure classes were diagnosed and resolved autonomously within a single correction cycle, and every run produces a provenance record satisfying FAIR data principles. These results show that the gap between knowing the physics and executing a validated simulation campaign can be bridged by a lightweight multi-agent orchestration layer, providing a pathway toward AI-driven materials discovery and self-driving laboratories.
tldr: AutoMOOSE is an agentic AI framework that automates the entire phase-field simulation lifecycle using a multi-agent pipeline, enabling easier adoption and faster execution with autonomous failure correction and FAIR data provenance.
tldr_zh: AutoMOOSE 是一个代理式 AI 框架，它使用多代理管道自动执行整个相场模拟生命周期，从而能够更容易地采用和更快地执行，具有自主故障校正和 FAIR 数据溯源。
summary_zh: 诸如MOOSE之类的多物理场仿真框架为相场材料建模提供了严格的引擎，但由于构建有效输入文件、协调参数扫描、诊断故障和提取定量结果所需的专业知识，限制了其应用。我们引入了AutoMOOSE，这是一个开源的代理框架，可以从单个自然语言提示协调完整的仿真生命周期。AutoMOOSE部署了一个五代理流水线，其中输入写入器协调六个子代理，审查器自主纠正运行时故障，无需用户干预。一个模块化的插件架构能够在不修改核心框架的情况下实现新的相场公式，并且模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器将工作流程公开为十个结构化工具，以便与任何MCP兼容的客户端进行互操作。在四温度铜晶粒长大基准测试中验证了AutoMOOSE，它生成的MOOSE输入文件中，有 12 个结构块中的 6 个与人类专家的参考完全匹配，4 个在功能上等效，以 1.8 倍的加速并行执行所有运行，并执行端到端的物理一致性检查，涵盖意图、有限元执行和Arrhenius动力学，无需人工验证。在 T >= 600 K 时，晶粒粗化动力学的回归分析R^2 = 0.90-0.95；在相同参数下，恢复的激活能 Q_fit = 0.296 eV 与人工编写的参考结果（Q_fit = 0.267 eV）一致。在单个校正周期内自主诊断并解决了三种运行时故障类别，并且每次运行都生成满足 FAIR 数据原则的溯源记录。这些结果表明，通过一个轻量级的多代理编排层，可以弥合了解物理原理和执行经过验证的仿真之间的差距，从而为人工智能驱动的材料发现和自驱动实验室提供了一条途径。

title: KHMP: Frequency-Domain Kalman Refinement for High-Fidelity Human Motion Prediction
summary: Stochastic human motion prediction aims to generate diverse, plausible futures from observed sequences. Despite advances in generative modeling, existing methods often produce predictions corrupted by high-frequency jitter and temporal discontinuities. To address these challenges, we introduce KHMP, a novel framework featuring an adaptiveKalman filter applied in the DCT domain to generate high-fidelity human motion predictions. By treating high-frequency DCT coefficients as a frequency-indexed noisy signal, the Kalman filter recursively suppresses noise while preserving motion details. Notably, its noise parameters are dynamically adjusted based on estimated Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), enabling aggressive denoising for jittery predictions and conservative filtering for clean motions. This refinement is complemented by training-time physical constraints (temporal smoothness and joint angle limits) that encode biomechanical principles into the generative model. Together, these innovations establish a new paradigm integrating adaptive signal processing with physics-informed learning. Experiments on the Human3.6M and HumanEva-I datasets demonstrate that KHMP achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, effectively mitigating jitter artifacts to produce smooth and physically plausible motions.
tldr: This paper proposes a Kalman filter-based refinement method in the DCT domain to generate high-fidelity human motion predictions, addressing issues of jitter and discontinuities by adaptively denoising motion sequences.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于卡尔曼滤波的DCT域优化方法，用于生成高保真的人体运动预测，通过自适应地对运动序列进行去噪，解决了抖动和不连续的问题。
summary_zh: 随机人体运动预测旨在从观察到的序列中生成多样且合理的未来运动。尽管生成建模取得了进展，但现有方法通常会产生受到高频抖动和时间不连续性破坏的预测结果。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的框架KHMP，该框架采用在DCT域中应用的自适应卡尔曼滤波器来生成高保真度的人体运动预测。通过将高频DCT系数视为一个频率索引的噪声信号，卡尔曼滤波器递归地抑制噪声，同时保留运动细节。值得注意的是，其噪声参数会根据估计的信噪比（SNR）动态调整，从而能够对抖动预测进行积极降噪，对干净运动进行保守滤波。这种精细化通过训练时期的物理约束（时间平滑性和关节角度限制）进行补充，这些约束将生物力学原理编码到生成模型中。总之，这些创新建立了一个将自适应信号处理与物理信息学习相结合的新范例。在Human3.6M和HumanEva-I数据集上的实验表明，KHMP达到了最先进的准确率，有效地减轻了抖动伪影，从而产生平滑且物理上合理的运动。

title: SGAD-SLAM: Splatting Gaussians at Adjusted Depth for Better Radiance Fields in RGBD SLAM
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has made remarkable progress in RGBD SLAM. Current methods usually use 3D Gaussians or view-tied 3D Gaussians to represent radiance fields in tracking and mapping. However, these Gaussians are either too flexible or too limited in movements, resulting in slow convergence or limited rendering quality. To resolve this issue, we adopt pixel-aligned Gaussians but allow each Gaussian to adjust its position along its ray to maximize the rendering quality, even if Gaussians are simplified to improve system scalability. To speed up the tracking, we model the depth distribution around each pixel as a Gaussian distribution, and then use these distributions to align each frame to the 3D scene quickly. We report our evaluations on widely used benchmarks, justify our designs, and show advantages over the latest methods in view rendering, camera tracking, runtime, and storage complexity. Please see our project page for code and videos at https://machineperceptionlab.github.io/SGAD-SLAM-Project .
tldr: The paper introduces SGAD-SLAM, a novel RGBD SLAM method that uses pixel-aligned Gaussians with adjustable depth to improve radiance field representation and accelerates tracking through depth distribution modeling, demonstrating superior performance in rendering, tracking, runtime, and storage.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SGAD-SLAM，一种新的RGBD SLAM方法，它采用具有可调深度的像素对齐高斯来改善辐射场表示，并通过深度分布建模来加速跟踪，从而在渲染、跟踪、运行速度和存储方面表现出优越的性能。
summary_zh: 3D高斯溅射(3DGS)在RGBD SLAM中取得了显著进展。目前的方法通常使用3D高斯或视角绑定的3D高斯来表示跟踪和建图中的辐射场。然而，这些高斯函数要么过于灵活，要么在运动方面受到限制，导致收敛缓慢或渲染质量有限。为了解决这个问题，我们采用像素对齐的高斯函数，但允许每个高斯函数沿着其射线调整其位置，以最大化渲染质量，即使高斯函数被简化以提高系统可扩展性。为了加速跟踪，我们将每个像素周围的深度分布建模为高斯分布，然后使用这些分布将每一帧快速对齐到3D场景。我们在广泛使用的基准上报告了我们的评估结果，证明了我们设计的合理性，并展示了我们在视图渲染、相机跟踪、运行时间和存储复杂度方面的优势。请访问我们的项目页面https://machineperceptionlab.github.io/SGAD-SLAM-Project 查看代码和视频。

title: ALMAB-DC: Active Learning, Multi-Armed Bandits, and Distributed Computing for Sequential Experimental Design and Black-Box Optimization
summary:
Sequential experimental design under expensive, gradient-free objectives is a central challenge in computational statistics: evaluation budgets are tightly constrained and information must be extracted efficiently from each observation. We propose \textbf{ALMAB-DC}, a GP-based sequential design framework combining active learning, multi-armed bandits (MAB), and distributed asynchronous computing for expensive black-box experimentation. A Gaussian process surrogate with uncertainty-aware acquisition identifies informative query points; a UCB or Thompson-sampling bandit controller allocates evaluations across parallel workers; and an asynchronous scheduler handles heterogeneous runtimes. We present cumulative regret bounds for the bandit components and characterize parallel scalability via Amdahl's Law.
  We validate ALMAB-DC on five benchmarks. On the two statistical experimental-design tasks, ALMAB-DC achieves lower simple regret than Equal Spacing, Random, and D-optimal designs in dose--response optimization, and in adaptive spatial field estimation matches the Greedy Max-Variance benchmark while outperforming Latin Hypercube Sampling; at $K=4$ the distributed setting reaches target performance in one-quarter of sequential wall-clock rounds. On three ML/engineering tasks (CIFAR-10 HPO, CFD drag minimization, MuJoCo RL), ALMAB-DC achieves 93.4\% CIFAR-10 accuracy (outperforming BOHB by 1.7\,pp and Optuna by 1.1\,pp), reduces airfoil drag to $C_D = 0.059$ (36.9\% below Grid Search), and improves RL return by 50\% over Grid Search. All advantages over non-ALMAB baselines are statistically significant under Bonferroni-corrected Mann--Whitney $U$ tests. Distributed execution achieves $7.5\times$ speedup at $K = 16$ agents, consistent with Amdahl's Law.
tldr: The paper introduces ALMAB-DC, a Gaussian Process based framework for sequential experimental design and black-box optimization by combining active learning, multi-armed bandits, and distributed computing, demonstrating strong performance on statistical experimental design and machine learning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ALMAB-DC，一个基于高斯过程的框架，通过结合主动学习、多臂老虎机和分布式计算来进行序列实验设计和黑盒优化，并在统计实验设计和机器学习任务上表现出强大的性能。
summary_zh:
以下是翻译结果：

在计算统计中，代价高昂且无梯度目标下的序贯实验设计是一项核心挑战：评估预算受到严格限制，且必须从每次观测中高效提取信息。我们提出\textbf{ALMAB-DC}，一个基于高斯过程的序贯设计框架，结合主动学习、多臂老虎机(MAB)和分布式异步计算，用于代价高昂的黑盒实验。高斯过程代理模型通过不确定性感知的获取函数来识别信息丰富的查询点；UCB或Thompson抽样老虎机控制器在并行工作者之间分配评估资源；异步调度器处理异构运行时。我们为老虎机组件提供累积遗憾界，并通过阿姆达尔定律描述并行可扩展性。

我们在五个基准上验证了ALMAB-DC。在两个统计实验设计任务中，ALMAB-DC在剂量-反应优化中实现了比等间距、随机和D-最优设计更低的简单遗憾，并且在自适应空间场估计中与贪婪最大方差基准相匹配，同时优于拉丁超立方抽样；在$K=4$时，分布式设置在四分之一的序贯运行轮次内达到目标性能。在三个ML/工程任务（CIFAR-10 HPO、CFD阻力最小化、MuJoCo RL）中，ALMAB-DC实现了93.4%的CIFAR-10准确率（比BOHB高1.7个百分点，比Optuna高1.1个百分点），将翼型阻力降低到$C_D = 0.059$（比网格搜索低36.9%），并将RL回报提高了比网格搜索高50%。在经过Bonferroni校正的Mann-Whitney $U$检验下，所有相对非ALMAB基线优势都具有统计显著性。分布式执行在$K = 16$个代理时实现了$7.5\times$的加速，与阿姆达尔定律一致。

title: Learning to Optimize Joint Source and RIS-assisted Channel Encoding for Multi-User Semantic Communication Systems
summary: In this paper, we explore a joint source and reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted channel encoding (JSRE) framework for multi-user semantic communications, where a deep neural network (DNN) extracts semantic features for all users and the RIS provides channel orthogonality, enabling a unified semantic encoding-decoding design. We aim to maximize the overall energy efficiency of semantic communications across all users by jointly optimizing the user scheduling, the RIS's phase shifts, and the semantic compression ratio. Although this joint optimization problem can be addressed using conventional deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods, evaluating semantic similarity typically relies on extensive real environment interactions, which can incur heavy computational overhead during training. To address this challenge, we propose a truncated DRL (T-DRL) framework, where a DNN-based semantic similarity estimator is developed to rapidly estimate the similarity score. Moreover, the user scheduling strategy is tightly coupled with the semantic model configuration. To exploit this relationship, we further propose a semantic model caching mechanism that stores and reuses fine-tuned semantic models corresponding to different scheduling decisions. A Transformer-based actor network is employed within the DRL framework to dynamically generate action space conditioned on the current caching state. This avoids redundant retraining and further accelerates the convergence of the learning process. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed JSRE framework significantly improves the system energy efficiency compared with the baseline methods. By training fewer semantic models, the proposed T-DRL framework significantly enhances the learning efficiency.
tldr: This paper proposes a truncated deep reinforcement learning (T-DRL) framework for joint source and RIS-assisted channel encoding in multi-user semantic communication systems, aiming to improve energy efficiency by optimizing user scheduling, RIS phase shifts, and semantic compression, while also addressing training efficiency with a semantic similarity estimator and model caching.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种截断深度强化学习（T-DRL）框架，用于多用户语义通信系统中联合源和RIS辅助的信道编码，旨在通过优化用户调度、RIS相移和语义压缩来提高能量效率，同时利用语义相似度估计器和模型缓存来解决训练效率问题。
summary_zh: 本文探讨了一种用于多用户语义通信的联合信源与可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助信道编码（JSRE）框架。该框架中，深度神经网络（DNN）提取所有用户的语义特征，RIS提供信道正交性，从而实现统一的语义编码-解码设计。我们的目标是通过联合优化用户调度、RIS的相移以及语义压缩比，最大化所有用户的语义通信总体能量效率。尽管这种联合优化问题可以使用传统的深度强化学习（DRL）方法解决，但评估语义相似性通常依赖于大量的真实环境交互，这会在训练过程中产生巨大的计算开销。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种截断DRL（T-DRL）框架，其中开发了一种基于DNN的语义相似性估计器来快速估计相似度得分。此外，用户调度策略与语义模型配置紧密耦合。为了利用这种关系，我们进一步提出了一种语义模型缓存机制，用于存储和重用对应于不同调度决策的微调语义模型。在DRL框架内采用基于Transformer的行动者网络，以根据当前的缓存状态，动态生成行动空间。这避免了冗余的重新训练，并进一步加速了学习过程的收敛。数值结果表明，与基线方法相比，所提出的JSRE框架显著提高了系统能量效率。通过训练更少的语义模型，所提出的T-DRL框架显著提高了学习效率。

title: Architecture for Multi-Unmanned Aerial Vehicles based Autonomous Precision Agriculture Systems
summary: The use of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in precision agriculture has seen a huge increase recently. As such, systems that aim to apply various algorithms on the field need a structured framework of abstractions. This paper defines the various tasks of the UAVs in precision agriculture and model them into an architectural framework. The presented architecture is built on the context that there will be minimal physical intervention to do the tasks defined with multiple coordinated and cooperative UAVs. Various tasks such as image processing, path planning, communication, data acquisition, and field mapping are employed in the architecture to provide an efficient system. Besides, different limitation for applying Multi-UAVs in precision agriculture has been considered in designing the architecture. The architecture provides an autonomous end-to-end solution, starting from mission planning, data acquisition and image processing framework that is highly efficient and can enable farmers to comprehensively deploy UAVs onto their lands. Simulation and field tests shows that the architecture offers a number of advantages that include fault-tolerance, robustness, developer and user-friendliness.
tldr: This paper presents an architectural framework for multi-UAV systems in precision agriculture, emphasizing autonomous operation and minimal physical intervention. Simulation and field tests suggest fault-tolerance and user-friendliness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于精准农业中多无人机系统的架构框架，重点强调自主运行和最小程度的人工干预。仿真和现场测试表明该架构具有容错性和用户友好性。
summary_zh: 无人驾驶飞行器（UAV）在精准农业中的应用近年来呈现显著增长。因此，旨在对农田应用各种算法的系统需要一个结构化的抽象框架。本文定义了无人机在精准农业中的各项任务，并将其建模为一个架构框架。所提出的架构基于以下背景：以最少的物理干预，通过多个协同合作的无人机来完成定义好的任务。图像处理、路径规划、通信、数据采集和农田测绘等各种任务被应用到该架构中，以提供一个高效的系统。此外，在架构设计中还考虑了在精准农业中应用多无人机时的各种限制因素。该架构提供了一个自主的端到端解决方案，从任务规划、数据采集到图像处理，该框架高效且能使农民全面地将无人机部署到他们的土地上。仿真和现场测试表明，该架构具有诸多优势，包括容错性、稳健性、开发者友好性和用户友好性。

title: Implementing Robust M-Estimators with Certifiable Factor Graph Optimization
summary:
Parameter estimation in robotics and computer vision faces formidable challenges from both outlier contamination and nonconvex optimization landscapes. While M-estimation addresses the problem of outliers through robust loss functions, it creates severely nonconvex problems that are difficult to solve globally. Adaptive reweighting schemes provide one particularly appealing strategy for implementing M-estimation in practice: these methods solve a sequence of simpler weighted least squares (WLS) subproblems, enabling both the use of standard least squares solvers and the recovery of higher-quality estimates than simple local search. However, adaptive reweighting still crucially relies upon solving the inner WLS problems effectively, a task that remains challenging in many robotics applications due to the intrinsic nonconvexity of many common parameter spaces (e.g. rotations and poses).
  In this paper, we show how one can easily implement adaptively reweighted M-estimators with certifiably correct solvers for the inner WLS subproblems using only fast local optimization over smooth manifolds. Our approach exploits recent work on certifiable factor graph optimization to provide global optimality certificates for the inner WLS subproblems while seamlessly integrating into existing factor graph-based software libraries and workflows. Experimental evaluation on pose-graph optimization and landmark SLAM tasks demonstrates that our adaptively reweighted certifiable estimation approach provides higher-quality estimates than alternative local search-based methods, while scaling tractably to realistic problem sizes.
tldr: The paper introduces a method for robust parameter estimation using adaptively reweighted M-estimators with certifiably correct solvers for Weighted Least Squares (WLS) subproblems, integrated into factor graph optimization for robotics and computer vision tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种稳健的参数估计方法，该方法使用自适应重加权M估计器和经认证的WLS子问题的正确求解器，并将其集成到机器人和计算机视觉任务的因子图优化中。
summary_zh:
机器人和计算机视觉中的参数估计面临来自异常值污染和非凸优化地形的双重严峻挑战。虽然 M-估计通过鲁棒损失函数解决了异常值的问题，但它产生了难以全局求解的严重非凸问题。自适应重加权方案为在实践中实施 M-估计提供了一种特别吸引人的策略：这些方法求解一系列更简单的加权最小二乘（WLS）子问题，从而能够使用标准最小二乘求解器，并获得比简单局部搜索更高质量的估计。然而，自适应重加权仍然至关重要地依赖于有效地求解内部 WLS 问题，由于许多常见参数空间（例如，旋转和位姿）的固有非凸性，这项任务在许多机器人应用中仍然具有挑战性。

在本文中，我们展示了如何仅使用光滑流形上的快速局部优化，用可验证正确的求解器为内部 WLS 子问题轻松实现自适应重加权的 M-估计。我们的方法利用了最近在可验证因子图优化方面的工作，为内部 WLS 子问题提供全局最优性证明，同时无缝集成到现有的基于因子图的软件库和工作流程中。在位姿图优化和地标 SLAM 任务上的实验评估表明，我们的自适应重加权可验证估计方法提供了比其他基于局部搜索的方法更高质量的估计，同时可以有效地扩展到实际问题规模。

title: A Two-stage Transformer Framework for Temporal Localization of Distracted Driver Behaviors
summary: The identification of hazardous driving behaviors from in-cabin video streams is essential for enhancing road safety and supporting the detection of traffic violations and unsafe driver actions. However, current temporal action localization techniques often struggle to balance accuracy with computational efficiency. In this work, we develop and evaluate a temporal action localization framework tailored for driver monitoring scenarios, particularly suitable for periodic inspection settings such as transportation safety checkpoints or fleet management assessment systems. Our approach follows a two-stage pipeline that combines VideoMAE-based feature extraction with an Augmented Self-Mask Attention (AMA) detector, enhanced by a Spatial Pyramid Pooling-Fast (SPPF) module to capture multi-scale temporal features. Experimental results reveal a distinct trade-off between model capacity and efficiency. At the feature extraction stage, the ViT-Giant backbone delivers higher representations with 88.09% Top-1 test accuracy, while the ViT-based variant proves to be a practical alternative, achieving 82.55% accuracy with significantly lower computational fine-tuning costs (101.85 GFLOPs/segment compared to 1584.06 GFLOPs/segment for Giant). In the downstream localization task, the integration of SPPF consistently improves performance across all configurations. Notably, the ViT-Giant + SPPF model achieves a peak mAP of 92.67%, while the lightweight ViT-based configuration maintains robust results.
tldr: This paper presents a two-stage Transformer framework using VideoMAE and Augmented Self-Mask Attention for temporal localization of distracted driver behaviors, balancing accuracy and efficiency for driver monitoring applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段Transformer框架，使用VideoMAE和增强的自掩码注意力机制，用于驾驶员分心行为的时间定位，从而在驾驶员监控应用中平衡了准确性和效率。
summary_zh: 从车内视频流中识别危险驾驶行为对于提高道路安全以及支持交通违规和不安全驾驶行为的检测至关重要。然而，当前的时间动作定位技术通常难以平衡准确性和计算效率。在这项工作中，我们开发并评估了一个针对驾驶员监控场景量身定制的时间动作定位框架，尤其适用于周期性检查场景，例如运输安全检查站或车队管理评估系统。我们的方法遵循一个两阶段流程，该流程将基于VideoMAE的特征提取与增强型自掩码注意力（AMA）检测器相结合，并通过空间金字塔池化快速（SPPF）模块增强，以捕获多尺度时间特征。实验结果揭示了模型容量和效率之间明显的权衡。在特征提取阶段，ViT-Giant骨干网络以88.09%的Top-1测试准确率提供了更高的表示能力，而基于ViT的变体被证明是一种实用的替代方案，以显著降低的计算微调成本（每个片段101.85 GFLOPs，而Giant为每个片段1584.06 GFLOPs）实现了82.55%的准确率。在下游定位任务中，SPPF的集成始终提高了所有配置的性能。值得注意的是，ViT-Giant + SPPF模型实现了92.67%的峰值mAP，而轻量级基于ViT的配置保持了稳健的结果。

title: EmoTaG: Emotion-Aware Talking Head Synthesis on Gaussian Splatting with Few-Shot Personalization
summary: Audio-driven 3D talking head synthesis has advanced rapidly with Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). By leveraging rich pre-trained priors, few-shot methods enable instant personalization from just a few seconds of video. However, under expressive facial motion, existing few-shot approaches often suffer from geometric instability and audio-emotion mismatch, highlighting the need for more effective emotion-aware motion modeling. In this work, we present EmoTaG, a few-shot emotion-aware 3D talking head synthesis framework built on the Pretrain-and-Adapt paradigm. Our key insight is to reformulate motion prediction in a structured FLAME parameter space rather than directly deforming 3D Gaussians, thereby introducing explicit geometric priors that improve motion stability. Building upon this, we propose a Gated Residual Motion Network (GRMN), which captures emotional prosody from audio while supplementing head pose and upper-face cues absent from audio, enabling expressive and coherent motion generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EmoTaG achieves state-of-the-art performance in emotional expressiveness, lip synchronization, visual realism, and motion stability.
tldr: EmoTaG is a new few-shot talking head synthesis framework that uses structured FLAME parameters and a Gated Residual Motion Network (GRMN) for improved emotional expressiveness and motion stability, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: EmoTaG是一个新的few-shot talking head合成框架，它使用结构化的FLAME参数和一个门控残差运动网络（GRMN）来提高情感表达能力和运动稳定性，达到了state-of-the-art的性能。
summary_zh: 音频驱动的3D说话头合成领域借助神经辐射场（NeRF）和3D高斯溅射（3DGS）技术取得了快速进展。通过利用丰富的预训练先验，少样本方法仅需几秒的视频即可实现即时个性化。然而，在富有表现力的面部运动下，现有的少样本方法通常会遭受几何不稳定性和音频-情感不匹配的问题，突出了对更有效的情感感知运动建模的需求。在这项工作中，我们提出了EmoTaG，一个基于预训练-微调范式的少样本情感感知3D说话头合成框架。我们核心的洞见在于，将运动预测重新构建在一个结构化的FLAME参数空间中，而不是直接变形3D高斯函数，从而引入了显式的几何先验，以提高运动的稳定性。在此基础上，我们提出了一个门控残差运动网络（GRMN），它从音频中捕获情感韵律，同时补充音频中缺失的头部姿态和上半脸线索，从而实现富有表现力和连贯的运动生成。大量的实验表明，EmoTaG在情感表现力、唇形同步、视觉真实性和运动稳定性方面均达到了最先进的性能。
